questions.q: Let the position vectors of three vertices of a triangle be \(4\vec p+\vec q-3\vec r\), \(-5\vec p+\vec q+2\vec r\) and \(2\vec p-\vec q+2\vec r\). If the position vectors of the orthocenter and the circumcenter of the triangle are \(\dfrac{\vec p+\vec q+\vec r}4\) and \(\alpha\vec p+\beta\vec q+\gamma\vec r\) respectively, then \(\alpha+2\beta+5\gamma\) is equal to:
questions.sol: The centroid is \(G=\tfrac{\vec p+\vec q+\vec r}3\) and \(O=\tfrac{3G-H}2=\tfrac38(\vec p+\vec q+\vec r)\). So \(\alpha=\beta=\gamma=\tfrac38\) and \(\alpha+2\beta+5\gamma=3\).

questions.q: If the components of \(\vec a=\alpha\hat i+\beta\hat j+\gamma\hat k\) along and perpendicular to \(\vec b=3\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\) respectively, are \(\dfrac{16}{11}(3\hat i+\hat j-\hat k)\) and \(\dfrac1{11}(-4\hat i-5\hat j-17\hat k)\), then \(\alpha^2+\beta^2+\gamma^2\) is equal to :
questions.sol: \(\vec a\) is the sum of the two components: \((4,1,-3)\).

questions.q: Let the position vectors of the vertices \(A,B\) and \(C\) of a triangle be \(2\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k\), \(\hat i+2\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(2\hat i+\hat j+2\hat k\) respectively. Let \(l_1,l_2\) and \(l_3\) be the lengths of perpendiculars drawn from the orthocenter of the triangle on the sides \(AB,BC\) and \(CA\) respectively, then \(l_1^2+l_2^2+l_3^2\) equals :
questions.sol: All sides are \(\sqrt2\): the triangle is equilateral, so each \(l_i\) is the inradius \(\tfrac{\sqrt2}{2\sqrt3}\), \(l_i^2=\tfrac16\).

questions.q: The position vectors of the vertices \(A,B\) and \(C\) of a triangle are \(2\hat i-3\hat j+3\hat k\), \(2\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k\) and \(-\hat i+\hat j+3\hat k\) respectively. Let \(l\) denotes the length of the angle bisector \(AD\) of \(\angle BAC\) where \(D\) is on the line segment \(BC\), then \(2l^2\) equals :
questions.sol: \(AB=5,\ AC=5\), so \(D\) is the midpoint \(\left(\tfrac12,\tfrac32,3\right)\); \(l^2=\tfrac94+\tfrac{81}4=\tfrac{45}2\).

questions.q: Let \(O\) be the origin and the position vectors of \(A\) and \(B\) be \(2\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k\) and \(2\hat i+4\hat j+4\hat k\) respectively. If the internal bisector of \(\angle AOB\) meets the line \(AB\) at \(C\), then the length of \(OC\) is
questions.sol: \(OA=3,\ OB=6\): \(C\) divides \(AB\) in \(1:2\), \(C=\tfrac{2A+B}3=\left(2,\tfrac83,2\right)\); \(OC=\tfrac{\sqrt{136}}3\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) be three non-zero vectors such that \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) are non-collinear. If \(\vec a+5\vec b\) is collinear with \(\vec c\), \(\vec b+6\vec c\) is collinear with \(\vec a\) and \(\vec a+\alpha\vec b+\beta\vec c=\vec 0\), then \(\alpha+\beta\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec a=\lambda\vec c-5\vec b\) and \(\vec b+6\vec c=\mu\vec a\) give \(\mu=-\tfrac15\), \(\lambda=-30\): \(\vec a+5\vec b+30\vec c=\vec0\).

questions.q: If the points \(P\) and \(Q\) are respectively the circumcenter and the orthocentre of a \(\Delta ABC\), then \(\overrightarrow{PA}+\overrightarrow{PB}+\overrightarrow{PC}\) is
questions.sol: With the circumcentre as origin, the orthocentre is \(\vec a+\vec b+\vec c\).

questions.q:
For any vector \(\vec a=a_1\hat i+a_2\hat j+a_3\hat k\), with \(10|a_i|<1\), \(i=1,2,3\), consider the following statements :
(A) : \(\max\{|a_1|,|a_2|,|a_3|\}\le|\vec a|\)
(B) : \(|\vec a|\le3\max\{|a_1|,|a_2|,|a_3|\}\)
questions.sol: \(\max|a_i|\le|\vec a|\le\sqrt3\max|a_i|\le3\max|a_i|\).

questions.q: Let \(ABCD\) be a quadrilateral. If \(E\) and \(F\) are the mid points of the diagonals \(AC\) and \(BD\) respectively and \((\overrightarrow{AB}-\overrightarrow{BC})+(\overrightarrow{AD}-\overrightarrow{DC})=k\overrightarrow{FE}\), then \(k\) is equal to
questions.sol: The left side is \(2\vec b+2\vec d-2\vec a-2\vec c=4\vec f-4\vec e=-4\overrightarrow{FE}\).

questions.q: Let a vector \(\alpha\hat i+\beta\hat j\) be obtained by rotating the vector \(\sqrt3\hat i+\hat j\) by an angle \(45^\circ\) about the origin in counterclockwise direction in the first quadrant. Then the area of triangle having vertices \((\alpha,\beta)\), \((0,\beta)\) and \((0,0)\) is equal to
questions.sol: The new vector has length \(2\) at angle \(75^\circ\): area \(\tfrac12\alpha\beta=\tfrac12\cdot4\sin75^\circ\cos75^\circ=\tfrac12\).

questions.q: A vector \(\vec a\) has components \(3p\) and \(1\) with respect to a rectangular cartesian system. This system is rotated through a certain angle about the origin in the counter clockwise sense. If, with respect to new system, \(\vec a\) has components \(p+1\) and \(\sqrt{10}\), then a value of \(p\) is
questions.sol: Length is unchanged: \(9p^2+1=(p+1)^2+10\Rightarrow4p^2-p-5=0\), \(p=-1\) or \(\tfrac54\).

questions.q: If vectors \(\vec a_1=x\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec a_2=\hat i+y\hat j+z\hat k\) are collinear, then a possible unit vector parallel to the vector \(x\hat i+y\hat j+z\hat k\) is
questions.sol: \(\vec a_1=x\vec a_2\) gives \(y=-\tfrac1x,\ z=\tfrac1x\). With \(x=1\): \((1,-1,1)\).

questions.q: If a unit vector \(\vec a\) makes angles \(\pi/3\) with \(\hat i\), \(\pi/4\) with \(\hat j\) and \(\theta\in(0,\pi)\) with \(\hat k\), then a value of \(\theta\) is
questions.sol: \(\cos^2\theta=1-\tfrac14-\tfrac12=\tfrac14\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec\alpha=(\lambda-2)\vec a+\vec b\) and \(\vec\beta=(4\lambda-2)\vec a+3\vec b\) be two given vectors where vectors \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) are non-collinear. The value of \(\lambda\) for which vectors \(\vec\alpha\) and \(\vec\beta\) are collinear, is
questions.sol: \(\dfrac{\lambda-2}{4\lambda-2}=\dfrac13\).

questions.q: Let \(\sqrt3\hat i+\hat j\), \(\hat i+\sqrt3\hat j\) and \(\beta\hat i+(1-\beta)\hat j\) respectively be the position vectors of the points \(A,B\) and \(C\) with respect to the origin \(O\). If the distance of \(C\) from the bisector of the acute angle between \(OA\) and \(OB\) is \(\dfrac3{\sqrt2}\), then the sum of all possible values of \(\beta\) is
questions.sol: The bisector is \(y=x\): \(\tfrac{|2\beta-1|}{\sqrt2}=\tfrac3{\sqrt2}\Rightarrow\beta=2,-1\).

questions.q: If the position vectors of the vertices \(A,B\) and \(C\) of a \(\Delta ABC\) are respectively \(4\hat i+7\hat j+8\hat k\), \(2\hat i+3\hat j+4\hat k\) and \(2\hat i+5\hat j+7\hat k\), then the position vector of the point, where the bisector of \(\angle A\) meets \(BC\) is

Let \(ABC\) be a triangle whose circumcentre is at \(P\). If the position vectors of \(A,B,C\) and \(P\) are \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) and \(\dfrac{\vec a+\vec b+\vec c}4\) respectively, then the position vector of the orthocentre of this triangle, is
questions.sol: \(H=3G-2P=(\vec a+\vec b+\vec c)-\tfrac12(\vec a+\vec b+\vec c)\).

questions.q: If the vectors \(\overrightarrow{AB}=3\hat i+4\hat k\) and \(\overrightarrow{AC}=5\hat i-2\hat j+4\hat k\) are the sides of a triangle \(ABC\), then the length of the median through \(A\) is
questions.sol: \(\tfrac12|\overrightarrow{AB}+\overrightarrow{AC}|=\tfrac12|(8,-2,8)|=\sqrt{33}\).

questions.q: The vector \(\vec a=\alpha\hat i+2\hat j+\beta\hat k\) lies in the plane of the vectors \(\vec b=\hat i+\hat j\) and \(\vec c=\hat j+\hat k\) and bisects the angle between \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\). Then which one of the following gives possible values of \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\)?
questions.sol: \(|\vec b|=|\vec c|\), so \(\vec a\parallel\vec b+\vec c=(1,2,1)\).

questions.q: If \(C\) is the mid point of \(AB\) and \(P\) is any point outside \(AB\), then
questions.sol: Section formula for the midpoint.

questions.q: Let \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) be three non-zero vectors such that no two of these are collinear. If the vector \(\vec a+2\vec b\) is collinear with \(\vec c\) and \(\vec b+3\vec c\) is collinear with \(\vec a\) (\(\lambda\) being some non-zero scalar) then \(\vec a+2\vec b+6\vec c\) equals
questions.sol: \(\vec a=\lambda\vec c-2\vec b\) and \(\vec b+3\vec c=\mu\vec a\) give \(\mu=-\tfrac12\), \(\lambda=-6\).

questions.q: Consider \(A,B,C\) and \(D\) with position vectors \(7\hat i-4\hat j+7\hat k\), \(\hat i-6\hat j+10\hat k\), \(-\hat i-3\hat j+4\hat k\) and \(5\hat i-\hat j+5\hat k\) respectively. Then \(ABCD\) is a
questions.sol: \(\overrightarrow{AB}=(-6,-2,3)\), \(\overrightarrow{DC}=(-6,-2,-1)\): not equal, so not even a parallelogram.

questions.q: Let the three sides of a triangle \(ABC\) be given by the vectors \(2\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\), \(\hat i-3\hat j-5\hat k\) and \(3\hat i-4\hat j-4\hat k\). Let \(G\) be the centroid of the triangle \(ABC\). Then \(6\left(|\overrightarrow{AG}|^2+|\overrightarrow{BG}|^2+|\overrightarrow{CG}|^2\right)\) is equal to ______.
If \(\vec a\) is a nonzero vector such that its projections on the vectors \(2\hat i-\hat j+2\hat k\), \(\hat i+2\hat j-2\hat k\) and \(\hat k\) are equal, then a unit vector along \(\vec a\) is :

Consider two vectors \(\vec u=3\hat i-\hat j\) and \(\vec v=2\hat i+\hat j-\lambda\hat k\), \(\lambda>0\). The angle between them is given by \(\cos^{-1}\left(\dfrac{\sqrt5}{2\sqrt7}\right)\). Let \(\vec v=\vec v_1+\vec v_2\), where \(\vec v_1\) is parallel to \(\vec u\) and \(\vec v_2\) is perpendicular to \(\vec u\). Then the value \(|\vec v_1|^2+|\vec v_2|^2\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\dfrac{5}{\sqrt{10}\sqrt{5+\lambda^2}}=\dfrac{\sqrt5}{2\sqrt7}\Rightarrow\lambda=3\). By Pythagoras \(|\vec v_1|^2+|\vec v_2|^2=|\vec v|^2=14\).

questions.q: Let the angle \(\theta,\ 0<\theta<\dfrac\pi2\) between two unit vectors \(\hat a\) and \(\hat b\) be \(\sin^{-1}\left(\dfrac{\sqrt{65}}9\right)\). If the vector \(\vec c=3\hat a+6\hat b+9(\hat a\times\hat b)\), then the value of \(9(\vec c\cdot\hat a)-3(\vec c\cdot\hat b)\) is
questions.sol: \(\cos\theta=\tfrac49\). \(\vec c\cdot\hat a=3+6\cos\theta\), \(\vec c\cdot\hat b=3\cos\theta+6\): \(9\cdot\tfrac{17}3-3\cdot\tfrac{22}3=29\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) be the vectors of the same magnitude such that \(\dfrac{|\vec a+\vec b|+|\vec a-\vec b|}{|\vec a+\vec b|-|\vec a-\vec b|}=\sqrt2+1\). Then \(\dfrac{|\vec a+\vec b|^2}{|\vec a|^2}\) is :
questions.sol: \(|\vec a\pm\vec b|=2|\vec a|\cos\tfrac\theta2,\ 2|\vec a|\sin\tfrac\theta2\), so \(\tan\tfrac\theta2=\sqrt2-1\), \(\theta=\tfrac\pi4\). Ratio \(4\cos^2\tfrac\pi8=2+\sqrt2\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec b=2\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\). Let \(\hat c\) be a unit vector in the plane of the vectors \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) and be perpendicular to \(\vec a\). Then such a vector \(\hat c\) is :
questions.sol: \(\vec b-\tfrac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec a|^2}\vec a=(2,1,-1)-\tfrac12(1,2,1)=\tfrac32(1,0,-1)\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) be two unit vectors such that the angle between them is \(\dfrac\pi3\). If \(\lambda\vec a+2\vec b\) and \(3\vec a-\lambda\vec b\) are perpendicular to each other, then the number of values of \(\lambda\) in \([-1,3]\) is :
questions.sol: \(3\lambda-\tfrac{\lambda^2}2+3-2\lambda=0\Rightarrow\lambda^2-2\lambda-6=0\), \(\lambda=1\pm\sqrt7\), neither in \([-1,3]\).

questions.q: Let the arc \(AC\) of a circle subtend a right angle at the centre \(O\). If the point \(B\) on the arc \(AC\), divides the arc \(AC\) such that \(\dfrac{\text{length of arc }AB}{\text{length of arc }BC}=\dfrac15\), and \(\overrightarrow{OC}=\alpha\overrightarrow{OA}+\beta\overrightarrow{OB}\), then \(\alpha+\sqrt2(\sqrt3-1)\beta\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\angle AOB=15^\circ\). With \(\overrightarrow{OA}=(1,0)\), \(\overrightarrow{OC}=(0,1)\): \(\beta=\tfrac1{\sin15^\circ}=\sqrt6+\sqrt2\), \(\alpha=-\cot15^\circ=-(2+\sqrt3)\). Then \(\sqrt2(\sqrt3-1)\beta=4\).

questions.q: Let a unit vector which makes an angle of \(60^\circ\) with \(2\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k\) and an angle of \(45^\circ\) with \(\hat i-\hat k\) be \(\vec C\). Then \(\vec C+\left(-\dfrac12\hat i+\dfrac1{3\sqrt2}\hat j-\dfrac{\sqrt2}3\hat k\right)\) is
questions.sol: \(2x+2y-z=\tfrac32\), \(x-z=1\), \(x^2+y^2+z^2=1\): one solution is \(\vec C=\left(\tfrac12+\tfrac{\sqrt2}3,-\tfrac1{3\sqrt2},\tfrac{\sqrt2}3-\tfrac12\right)\), which gives option (c).

questions.q: For \(\lambda>0\), let \(\theta\) be the angle between the vectors \(\vec a=\hat i+\lambda\hat j-3\hat k\) and \(\vec b=3\hat i-\hat j+2\hat k\). If the vectors \(\vec a+\vec b\) and \(\vec a-\vec b\) are mutually perpendicular, then the value of \((14\cos\theta)^2\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(|\vec a|=|\vec b|\Rightarrow\lambda=2\); \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=-5\), \(\cos\theta=-\tfrac5{14}\).

questions.q: Let \(P(x,y,z)\) be a point in the first octant, whose projection in the \(xy\)-plane is the point \(Q\). Let \(OP=\gamma\); the angle between \(OQ\) and the positive \(x\)-axis be \(\theta\); and the angle between \(OP\) and the positive \(z\)-axis be \(\phi\), where \(O\) is the origin. Then the distance of \(P\) from the \(x\)-axis is
questions.sol: \(x=\gamma\sin\phi\cos\theta\); distance from the \(x\)-axis \(=\sqrt{\gamma^2-x^2}\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k\), \(\vec b=2\hat i+3\hat j-5\hat k\) and \(\vec c=3\hat i-\hat j+\lambda\hat k\) be three vectors. Let \(\vec r\) be a unit vector along \(\vec b+\vec c\). If \(\vec r\cdot\vec a=3\), then \(3\lambda\) is equal to :
questions.sol: \(\vec b+\vec c=(5,2,\lambda-5)\): \((3\lambda-6)^2=9\left(29+(\lambda-5)^2\right)\Rightarrow\lambda=\tfrac{25}3\).

questions.q: Consider a \(\Delta ABC\) where \(A(1,3,2)\), \(B(-2,8,0)\) and \(C(3,6,7)\). If the angle bisector of \(\angle BAC\) meets the line \(BC\) at \(D\), then the length of the projection of the vector \(\overrightarrow{AD}\) on the vector \(\overrightarrow{AC}\) is
questions.sol: \(AB=AC=\sqrt{38}\), so \(D=\left(\tfrac12,7,\tfrac72\right)\) and \(\overrightarrow{AD}=\left(-\tfrac12,4,\tfrac32\right)\). Projection \(\tfrac{-1+12+7.5}{\sqrt{38}}\).

questions.q: Let a unit vector \(\hat u=x\hat i+y\hat j+z\hat k\) make angles \(\dfrac\pi2,\dfrac\pi3\) and \(\dfrac{2\pi}3\) with the vectors \(\dfrac1{\sqrt2}\hat i+\dfrac1{\sqrt2}\hat k\), \(\dfrac1{\sqrt2}\hat j+\dfrac1{\sqrt2}\hat k\) and \(\dfrac1{\sqrt2}\hat i+\dfrac1{\sqrt2}\hat j\) respectively. If \(\vec v=\dfrac1{\sqrt2}\hat i+\dfrac1{\sqrt2}\hat j+\dfrac1{\sqrt2}\hat k\), then \(|\hat u-\vec v|^2\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(x+z=0\), \(y+z=\tfrac1{\sqrt2}\), \(x+y=-\tfrac1{\sqrt2}\): \(\hat u=\left(-\tfrac1{\sqrt2},0,\tfrac1{\sqrt2}\right)\). \(|\hat u-\vec v|^2=2+\tfrac12\).

questions.q: An arc \(PQ\) of a circle subtends a right angle at its centre \(O\). The mid point of the arc \(PQ\) is \(R\). If \(\overrightarrow{OP}=\vec u\), \(\overrightarrow{OR}=\vec v\) and \(\overrightarrow{OQ}=\alpha\vec u+\beta\vec v\), then \(\alpha,\beta^2\) are the roots of the equation
questions.sol: \(\vec v=\tfrac{\vec u+\overrightarrow{OQ}}{\sqrt2}\), so \(\overrightarrow{OQ}=-\vec u+\sqrt2\vec v\): \(\alpha=-1\), \(\beta^2=2\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=5\hat i-\hat j-3\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\hat i+3\hat j+5\hat k\) be two vectors. Then which one of the following statements is TRUE?
opts: Projection of \(\vec a\) on \(\vec b\) is \(\dfrac{17}{\sqrt{35}}\) and the direction of the projection vector is same as of \(\vec b\).
Projection of \(\vec a\) on \(\vec b\) is \(\dfrac{17}{\sqrt{35}}\) and the direction of the projection vector is opposite to the direction of \(\vec b\).
Projection \(\vec a\) on \(\vec b\) is \(\dfrac{-17}{\sqrt{35}}\) and the direction of the projection vector is same as of \(\vec b\).
Projection of \(\vec a\) on \(\vec b\) is \(\dfrac{-17}{\sqrt{35}}\) and the direction of the projection vector is opposite to the direction of \(\vec b\).
questions.sol: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=5-3-15=-13\), so the projection is \(-\tfrac{13}{\sqrt{35}}\) (opposite to \(\vec b\)). No option has the correct number; NTA treated the question as a bonus.

questions.q: Let \(\vec\alpha=4\hat i+3\hat j+5\hat k\) and \(\vec\beta=\hat i+2\hat j-4\hat k\). Let \(\vec\beta_1\) be parallel to \(\vec\alpha\) and \(\vec\beta_2\) be perpendicular to \(\vec\alpha\). If \(\vec\beta=\vec\beta_1+\vec\beta_2\), then the value of \(5\vec\beta_2\cdot(\hat i+\hat j+\hat k)\) is
questions.sol: \(\vec\beta_1=\tfrac{-10}{50}\vec\alpha\), \(\vec\beta_2=\vec\beta+\tfrac15\vec\alpha=\left(\tfrac95,\tfrac{13}5,-3\right)\). \(5\cdot\tfrac75=7\).

questions.q: The vector \(\vec a=-\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k\) is rotated through a right angle, passing through the \(y\)-axis in its way and the resulting vector is \(\vec b\). Then the projection of \(3\vec a+\sqrt2\vec b\) on \(\vec c=5\hat i+4\hat j+3\hat k\) is
questions.sol: \(\vec b\) lies in the plane of \(\vec a,\hat j\), is perpendicular to \(\vec a\) and has length \(\sqrt6\): \(\vec b=\sqrt2(1,1,-1)\). Then \(3\vec a+\sqrt2\vec b=(-1,8,1)\), projection \(\tfrac{30}{5\sqrt2}\).

questions.q:
Let \(\vec a=2\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\), and \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) be two non-zero vectors such that \(|\vec a+\vec b+\vec c|=|\vec a+\vec b-\vec c|\) and \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=0\). Consider the following two statements :
(A) \(|\vec a+\lambda\vec c|\ge|\vec a|\) for all \(\lambda\in R\).
(B) \(\vec a\) and \(\vec c\) are always parallel.
questions.sol: The condition gives \((\vec a+\vec b)\cdot\vec c=0\), so \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=0\). Then \(|\vec a+\lambda\vec c|^2=|\vec a|^2+\lambda^2|\vec c|^2\); and \(\vec a\perp\vec c\), not parallel.

questions.q: Let \(S\) be the set of all \(a\in R\) for which the angle between the vectors \(\vec u=a(\log_eb)\hat i-6\hat j+3\hat k\) and \(\vec v=(\log_eb)\hat i+2\hat j+2a(\log_eb)\hat k\), \((b>1)\) is acute. Then \(S\) is equal to
questions.sol: With \(t=\ln b>0\): \(\vec u\cdot\vec v=at^2+6at-12\) must be positive for every \(t>0\), impossible as \(t\to0^+\).

questions.q: Let \(\hat a\) and \(\hat b\) be two unit vectors such that the angle between them is \(\dfrac\pi4\). If \(\theta\) is the angle between the vectors \((\hat a+\hat b)\) and \((\hat a+2\hat b+2(\hat a\times\hat b))\), then the value of \(164\cos^2\theta\) is equal to :
questions.sol: Dot product \(3+3\cdot\tfrac1{\sqrt2}\); \(|\hat a+\hat b|^2=2+\sqrt2\), \(|\hat a+2\hat b+2\hat a\times\hat b|^2=5+2\sqrt2+2=7+2\sqrt2\). Then \(164\cos^2\theta=90+27\sqrt2\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=a_1\hat i+a_2\hat j+a_3\hat k\), \(a_i>0\), \(i=1,2,3\) be a vector which makes equal angles with the coordinate axes \(OX,OY\) and \(OZ\). Also, let the projection of \(\vec a\) on the vector \(3\hat i+4\hat j\) be \(7\). Let \(\vec b\) be a vector obtained by rotating \(\vec a\) with \(90^\circ\). If \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(x\)-axis are coplanar, then projection of a vector \(\vec b\) on \(3\hat i+4\hat j\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec a=5(1,1,1)\); \(\vec b\perp\vec a\), in the plane of \(\vec a,\hat i\), length \(5\sqrt3\): \(\vec b=\pm\tfrac5{\sqrt2}(2,-1,-1)\). Projection \(\tfrac{5}{\sqrt2}\cdot\tfrac25=\sqrt2\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) be two vectors such that \(|2\vec a+3\vec b|=|3\vec a+\vec b|\) and the angle between \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) is \(60^\circ\). If \(\dfrac18\vec a\) is a unit vector, then \(|\vec b|\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(5|\vec a|^2-6\vec a\cdot\vec b-8|\vec b|^2=0\) with \(|\vec a|=8\): \(|\vec b|^2+3|\vec b|-40=0\).

questions.q: In a triangle \(ABC\), if \(|\overrightarrow{BC}|=3\), \(|\overrightarrow{CA}|=5\), and \(|\overrightarrow{BA}|=7\), then the projection of the vector \(\overrightarrow{BA}\) on \(\overrightarrow{BC}\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(25=49+9-2\overrightarrow{BA}\cdot\overrightarrow{BC}\Rightarrow\overrightarrow{BA}\cdot\overrightarrow{BC}=\tfrac{33}2\); divide by \(3\).

questions.q: In a triangle \(ABC\), if \(|\overrightarrow{BC}|=8\), \(|\overrightarrow{CA}|=7\), \(|\overrightarrow{AB}|=10\), then the projection of the vector \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) on \(\overrightarrow{AC}\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(64=100+49-2\overrightarrow{AB}\cdot\overrightarrow{AC}\Rightarrow\overrightarrow{AB}\cdot\overrightarrow{AC}=\tfrac{85}2\); divide by \(7\).

questions.q: Let \(a,b,c\in R\) be such that \(a^2+b^2+c^2=1\). If \(a\cos\theta=b\cos\left(\theta+\dfrac{2\pi}3\right)=c\cos\left(\theta+\dfrac{4\pi}3\right)\), where \(\theta=\dfrac\pi9\), then the angle between the vectors \(a\hat i+b\hat j+c\hat k\) and \(b\hat i+c\hat j+a\hat k\) is
questions.sol: With the common value \(k\): \(ab+bc+ca=k^2\dfrac{\sum\cos\left(\theta+\frac{2r\pi}3\right)}{\prod\cos(\cdot)}=0\), since the three cosines add to \(0\).

questions.q: A vector \(\vec a=\alpha\hat i+2\hat j+\beta\hat k\) \((\alpha,\beta\in R)\) lies in the plane of the vectors, \(\vec b=\hat i+\hat j\) and \(\vec c=\hat i-\hat j+4\hat k\). If \(\vec a\) bisects the angle between \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\), then
questions.sol: \(\hat b\pm\hat c\propto(2,1,2)\) or \((1,2,-2)\). With \(y\)-component \(2\): \((4,2,4)\) or \((1,2,-2)\); the second satisfies \(\vec a\cdot\hat k+2=0\).

questions.q: Let \(A(3,0,-1)\), \(B(2,10,6)\) and \(C(1,2,1)\) be the vertices of a triangle and \(M\) be the midpoint of \(AC\). If \(G\) divides \(BM\) in the ratio, \(2:1\), then \(\cos(\angle GOA)\) (\(O\) being the origin) is equal to
questions.sol: \(G\) is the centroid \((2,4,2)\). \(\cos=\tfrac{6-2}{\sqrt{24}\sqrt{10}}\).

questions.q: The distance of the point having position vector \(-\hat i+2\hat j+6\hat k\) from the straight line passing through the point \((2,3,-4)\) and parallel to the vector, \(6\hat i+3\hat j-4\hat k\) is

Let \(\vec a=\hat i+\hat j+\sqrt2\hat k\), \(\vec b=b_1\hat i+b_2\hat j+\sqrt2\hat k\) and \(\vec c=5\hat i+\hat j+\sqrt2\hat k\) be three vectors such that the projection of \(\vec b\) on \(\vec a\) is \(|\vec a|\). If \(\vec a+\vec b\) is perpendicular to \(\vec c\), then \(|\vec b|\) is equal to

questions.sol: \(3-\lambda_2=2\lambda_1\) and \(6+6\lambda_1+3(\lambda_3-1)=0\). Option (b) satisfies both.

questions.q: In a triangle \(ABC\), right angled at the vertex \(A\), if the position vectors of \(A,B\) and \(C\) are respectively \(3\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\), \(-\hat i+3\hat j+p\hat k\) and \(5\hat i+q\hat j-4\hat k\), then the point \((p,q)\) lies on a line

making an acute angle with the positive direction of \(x\)-axis.
questions.sol: \(\overrightarrow{AB}\cdot\overrightarrow{AC}=0\Rightarrow2q-3p=13\), a line of slope \(\tfrac32\).

questions.q: In a parallelogram \(ABCD\), \(|\overrightarrow{AB}|=a\), \(|\overrightarrow{AD}|=b\) and \(|\overrightarrow{AC}|=c\), then \(\overrightarrow{DB}\cdot\overrightarrow{AB}\) has the value
questions.sol: \(\overrightarrow{AB}\cdot\overrightarrow{AD}=\tfrac{c^2-a^2-b^2}2\) and \(\overrightarrow{DB}\cdot\overrightarrow{AB}=a^2-\overrightarrow{AB}\cdot\overrightarrow{AD}\).

questions.q: If \(|\vec a|=2\), \(|\vec b|=3\) and \(|2\vec a-\vec b|=5\), then \(|2\vec a+\vec b|\) equals
questions.sol: \(16+9-4\vec a\cdot\vec b=25\Rightarrow\vec a\cdot\vec b=0\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=2\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\vec c=\hat i+\hat j-2\hat k\) be three vectors. A vector of the type \(\vec b+\lambda\vec c\) for some scalar \(\lambda\), whose projection on \(\vec a\) is of magnitude \(\sqrt{\dfrac23}\), is
questions.sol: Projection \(\tfrac{-(\lambda+1)}{\sqrt6}\); magnitude \(\sqrt{\tfrac23}\Rightarrow\lambda=1\) or \(-3\); \(\lambda=1\) gives \((2,3,-3)\).

questions.q: Let \(\hat a\) and \(\hat b\) be two unit vectors. If the vectors \(\vec c=\hat a+2\hat b\) and \(\vec d=5\hat a-4\hat b\) are perpendicular to each other, then the angle between \(\hat a\) and \(\hat b\) is
questions.sol: \(5-8+6\hat a\cdot\hat b=0\).

questions.q: Let \(ABCD\) be a parallelogram such that \(\overrightarrow{AB}=\vec q\), \(\overrightarrow{AD}=\vec p\) and \(\angle BAD\) be an acute angle. If \(\vec r\) is the vector that coincides with the altitude directed from the vertex \(B\) to the side \(AD\), then \(\vec r\) is given by
opts: \(\vec r=\vec q-\left(\dfrac{\vec p\cdot\vec q}{\vec p\cdot\vec p}\right)\vec p\)
\(\vec r=-3\vec q+\dfrac{3(\vec p\cdot\vec q)}{(\vec p\cdot\vec p)}\vec p\)
\(\vec r=3\vec q-\dfrac{3(\vec p\cdot\vec q)}{(\vec p\cdot\vec p)}\vec p\)
\(\vec r=-\vec q+\dfrac{(\vec p\cdot\vec q)}{(\vec p\cdot\vec p)}\vec p\)
questions.sol: With \(A\) as origin, the foot of the altitude is \(\tfrac{\vec p\cdot\vec q}{\vec p\cdot\vec p}\vec p\); subtract \(\vec q\).

questions.q: If the vectors \(\vec a=\hat i-\hat j+2\hat k\), \(\vec b=2\hat i+4\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec c=\lambda\hat i+\hat j+\mu\hat k\) are mutually orthogonal, then \((\lambda,\mu)=\)
questions.sol: \(\lambda-1+2\mu=0\) and \(2\lambda+4+\mu=0\).

questions.q: The non-zero vectors \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) are related by \(\vec a=8\vec b\) and \(\vec c=-7\vec b\). Then the angle between \(\vec a\) and \(\vec c\) is
questions.sol: \(\vec a\) and \(\vec c\) point in opposite directions.

questions.q: The values of \(a\), for which the points \(A,B,C\) with position vectors \(2\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\), \(\hat i-3\hat j-5\hat k\) and \(a\hat i-3\hat j+\hat k\) respectively are the vertices of a right-angled triangle at \(C\) are
questions.sol: \(\overrightarrow{CA}\cdot\overrightarrow{CB}=(2-a)(1-a)=0\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec u,\vec v,\vec w\) be such that \(|\vec u|=1,\ |\vec v|=2,\ |\vec w|=3\). If the projection of \(\vec v\) along \(\vec u\) is equal to that of \(\vec w\) along \(\vec u\) and \(\vec v,\vec w\) are perpendicular to each other, then \(|\vec u-\vec v+\vec w|\) equals
questions.sol: \(\vec u\cdot\vec v=\vec u\cdot\vec w\), \(\vec v\cdot\vec w=0\): \(|\vec u-\vec v+\vec w|^2=1+4+9\).

questions.q: A particle is acted upon by constant forces \(4\hat i+\hat j-3\hat k\) and \(3\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\) which displace it from a point \(\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k\) to the point \(5\hat i+4\hat j+\hat k\). The work done in standard units by the forces is given by

\(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) are three vectors, such that \(\vec a+\vec b+\vec c=0\), \(|\vec a|=1\), \(|\vec b|=2\), \(|\vec c|=3\), then \(\vec a\cdot\vec b+\vec b\cdot\vec c+\vec c\cdot\vec a\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(0=|\vec a+\vec b+\vec c|^2=14+2\sum\vec a\cdot\vec b\).

questions.q: If \(|\vec a|=5,\ |\vec b|=4,\ |\vec c|=3\) thus what will be the value of \(|\vec a\cdot\vec b+\vec b\cdot\vec c+\vec c\cdot\vec a|\), given that \(\vec a+\vec b+\vec c=0\)
questions.sol: \(\sum\vec a\cdot\vec b=-\tfrac{50}2\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) are vectors show that \(\vec a+\vec b+\vec c=0\) and \(|\vec a|=7,\ |\vec b|=5,\ |\vec c|=3\) then angle between vector \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) is

Let \(\vec a=\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b=3\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k\), \(\vec c=\lambda\hat j+\mu\hat k\) and \(\hat d\) be a unit vector such that \(\vec a\times\hat d=\vec b\times\hat d\) and \(\vec c\cdot\hat d=1\). If \(\vec c\) is perpendicular to \(\vec a\), then \(|3\lambda\hat d+\mu\vec c|^2\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \((\vec a-\vec b)\times\hat d=\vec0\Rightarrow\hat d=\pm\tfrac13(-2,-1,2)\). \(\lambda+\mu=0\) and \(\vec c\cdot\hat d=1\) give \(3\lambda\hat d=(2,1,-2)\) and \(\mu\vec c=(0,-1,1)\). Sum \((2,0,-1)\).

questions.q: The least positive integral value of \(\alpha\), for which the angle between the vectors \(\alpha\hat i-2\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(\alpha\hat i+2\alpha\hat j-2\hat k\) is acute, is ______.
questions.sol: \(\alpha^2-4\alpha-4>0\Rightarrow\alpha>2+2\sqrt2\approx4.83\).

questions.q: If the projection of the vector \(\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k\) on the sum of the two vectors \(2\hat i+4\hat j-5\hat k\) and \(-\lambda\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k\) is \(1\), then \(\lambda\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: Sum \((2-\lambda,6,-2)\): \((12-\lambda)^2=(2-\lambda)^2+40\Rightarrow\lambda=5\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) be three mutually perpendicular vectors of the same magnitude and equally inclined at an angle \(\theta\), with the vector \(\vec a+\vec b+\vec c\). Then \(36\cos^22\theta\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\cos\theta=\tfrac1{\sqrt3}\), \(\cos2\theta=-\tfrac13\).

questions.q: For \(p>0\), a vector \(\vec v_2=2\hat i+(p+1)\hat j\) is obtained by rotating the vector \(\vec v_1=\sqrt3p\hat i+\hat j\) by an angle \(\theta\) about origin in counter clockwise direction. If \(\tan\theta=\dfrac{(\alpha\sqrt3-2)}{(4\sqrt3+3)}\), then the value of \(\alpha\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: Equal lengths: \(3p^2+1=4+(p+1)^2\Rightarrow p=2\). \(\tan\theta=\dfrac{\frac32-\frac1{2\sqrt3}}{1+\frac3{4\sqrt3}}=\dfrac{6\sqrt3-2}{4\sqrt3+3}\).

questions.q: If \((\vec a+3\vec b)\) is perpendicular to \((7\vec a-5\vec b)\) and \((\vec a-4\vec b)\) is perpendicular to \((7\vec a-2\vec b)\), then the angle between \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) (in degrees) is ______.
questions.sol: \(7a^2+16\vec a\cdot\vec b-15b^2=0\) and \(7a^2-30\vec a\cdot\vec b+8b^2=0\) give \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=\tfrac{b^2}2\), \(a=b\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) be three unit vectors such that \(|\vec a-\vec b|^2+|\vec a-\vec c|^2=8\). Then \(|\vec a+2\vec b|^2+|\vec a+2\vec c|^2\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b+\vec a\cdot\vec c=-2\) forces \(\vec b=\vec c=-\vec a\); then each term is \(1\).

questions.q: Let the vectors \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) be such that \(|\vec a|=2,\ |\vec b|=4\) and \(|\vec c|=4\). If the projection of \(\vec b\) on \(\vec a\) is equal to the projection of \(\vec c\) on \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) is perpendicular to \(\vec c\), then the value of \(|\vec a+\vec b-\vec c|\) is ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=\vec a\cdot\vec c\), \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=0\): \(|\cdot|^2=4+16+16\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) are unit vectors, then the greatest value of \(\sqrt3|\vec a+\vec b|+|\vec a-\vec b|\) is ______.
questions.sol: \(2\sqrt3\cos\tfrac\theta2+2\sin\tfrac\theta2\le2\sqrt{3+1}\).

questions.q: If \(\vec x\) and \(\vec y\) be two non-zero vectors such that \(|\vec x+\vec y|=|\vec x|\) and \(2\vec x+\lambda\vec y\) is perpendicular to \(\vec y\), then the value of \(\lambda\) is ______.
questions.sol: \(2\vec x\cdot\vec y=-|\vec y|^2\), so \((2\vec x+\lambda\vec y)\cdot\vec y=(\lambda-1)|\vec y|^2=0\).

questions.q: The projection of the line segment joining the points \((1,-1,3)\) and \((2,-4,11)\) on the line joining the points \((-1,2,3)\) and \((3,-2,10)\) is ______.

Let \(ABCD\) be a tetrahedron such that the edges \(AB\), \(AC\) and \(AD\) are mutually perpendicular. Let the areas of the triangles \(ABC\), \(ACD\) and \(ADB\) be \(5\), \(6\) and \(7\) square units respectively. Then the area (in square units) of the \(\Delta BCD\) is equal to :
questions.sol: With \(A\) at the origin and edges along the axes, \(\tfrac12|\overrightarrow{BC}\times\overrightarrow{BD}|\) squared equals the sum of the squares of the three face areas: \(25+36+49\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=2\hat i-3\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b=3\hat i+2\hat j+5\hat k\) and a vector \(\vec c\) be such that \((\vec a-\vec c)\times\vec b=-18\hat i-3\hat j+12\hat k\) and \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=3\). If \(\vec b\times\vec c=\vec d\), then \(|\vec a\cdot\vec d|\) is equal to :

The altitude from the vertex \(D\) to the opposite face \(ABC\) meets the median line segment through \(A\) of the triangle \(ABC\) at the point \(E\). If the length of \(AD\) is \(\dfrac{\sqrt{110}}3\) and the volume of the tetrahedron is \(\dfrac{\sqrt{805}}{6\sqrt2}\), then the position vector of \(E\) is
questions.sol: \(\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}=(-5,-3,-1)\), area \(\tfrac{\sqrt{35}}2\); height \(DE=\tfrac{3V}{\text{area}}=\sqrt{\tfrac{23}2}\). \(AE^2=\tfrac{110}9-\tfrac{23}2=\tfrac{13}{18}\), while \(AM^2=\tfrac{13}2\): \(E=A+\tfrac13\overrightarrow{AM}=\left(\tfrac76,2,\tfrac16\right)\).

questions.q: Let the point \(A\) divide the line segment joining the points \(P(-1,-1,2)\) and \(Q(5,5,10)\) internally in the ratio \(r:1\) \((r>0)\). If \(O\) is the origin and \((\overrightarrow{OQ}\cdot\overrightarrow{OA})-\dfrac15|\overrightarrow{OP}\times\overrightarrow{OA}|^2=10\), then the value of \(r\) is:
questions.sol: \(A=\tfrac{(5r-1,5r-1,10r+2)}{r+1}\). Substituting and simplifying, the equation holds for \(r=7\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=3\hat i-\hat j+2\hat k\), \(\vec b=\vec a\times(\hat i-2\hat k)\) and \(\vec c=\vec b\times\hat k\). Then the projection of \(\vec c-2\hat j\) on \(\vec a\) is :

Let \(\vec a=2\hat i-\hat j+3\hat k\), \(\vec b=3\hat i-5\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec c\) be a vector such that \(\vec a\times\vec c=\vec c\times\vec b\) and \((\vec a+\vec c)\cdot(\vec b+\vec c)=168\). Then the maximum value of \(|\vec c|^2\) is :
questions.sol: \((\vec a+\vec b)\times\vec c=\vec0\Rightarrow\vec c=\lambda(5,-6,4)\). The dot condition gives \(77\lambda^2+77\lambda+14=168\), \(\lambda=1,-2\). Max \(77\cdot4\).

questions.q: Let \(\hat a\) be a unit vector perpendicular to the vectors \(\vec b=\hat i-2\hat j+3\hat k\) and \(\vec c=2\hat i+3\hat j-\hat k\), and makes an angle of \(\cos^{-1}\left(-\dfrac13\right)\) with the vector \(\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\). If \(\hat a\) makes an angle of \(\dfrac\pi3\) with the vector \(\hat i+\alpha\hat j+\hat k\), then the value of \(\alpha\) is :
questions.sol: \(\vec b\times\vec c\parallel(-1,1,1)\); the angle condition picks \(\hat a=\tfrac1{\sqrt3}(1,-1,-1)\). Then \(\tfrac{-\alpha}{\sqrt3\sqrt{2+\alpha^2}}=\tfrac12\Rightarrow\alpha=-\sqrt6\).

questions.q: If \(A(1,-1,2)\), \(B(5,7,-6)\), \(C(3,4,-10)\) and \(D(-1,-4,-2)\) are the vertices of a quadrilateral \(ABCD\), then its area is :
questions.sol: Area \(=\tfrac12|\overrightarrow{AC}\times\overrightarrow{BD}|=\tfrac12|(-112,64,8)|=12\sqrt{29}\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=2\hat i+5\hat j-\hat k\), \(\vec b=2\hat i-2\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(\vec c\) be three vectors such that \((\vec c+\hat i)\times(\vec a+\vec b+\hat i)=\vec a\times(\vec c+\hat i)\). If \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=-29\), then \(\vec c\cdot(-2\hat i+\hat j+\hat k)\) is equal to :
questions.sol: \((\vec c+\hat i)\times(2\vec a+\vec b+\hat i)=\vec0\), so \(\vec c+\hat i=\lambda(7,8,0)\). \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=54\lambda-2=-29\Rightarrow\lambda=-\tfrac12\): \(\vec c=\left(-\tfrac92,-4,0\right)\).

questions.q: Consider three vectors \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\). Let \(|\vec a|=2\), \(|\vec b|=3\) and \(\vec a=\vec b\times\vec c\). If \(\alpha\in\left[0,\dfrac\pi3\right]\) is the angle between the vectors \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\), then the minimum value of \(27|\vec c-\vec a|^2\) is equal to :
questions.sol: \(|\vec c|=\tfrac2{3\sin\alpha}\) and \(\vec a\perp\vec c\): \(|\vec c-\vec a|^2=\tfrac4{9\sin^2\alpha}+4\), least at \(\alpha=\tfrac\pi3\): \(\tfrac{16}{27}+4\).

questions.q: If \(A(3,1,-1)\), \(B\left(\dfrac53,\dfrac73,\dfrac13\right)\), \(C(2,2,1)\) and \(D\left(\dfrac{10}3,\dfrac23,\dfrac{-1}3\right)\) are the vertices of a quadrilateral \(ABCD\), then its area is
questions.sol: \(\tfrac12|\overrightarrow{AC}\times\overrightarrow{BD}|=\tfrac12\left|\left(\tfrac83,\tfrac83,0\right)\right|\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=2\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\), \(\vec b=((\vec a\times(\hat i+\hat j))\times\hat i)\times\hat i\). Then the square of the projection of \(\vec a\) on \(\vec b\) is :
questions.sol: \(\vec a\times(\hat i+\hat j)=(1,-1,1)\), then \(\times\hat i\): \((0,1,1)\), then \(\times\hat i\): \((0,1,-1)\). Projection \(\tfrac2{\sqrt2}\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=6\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\hat i+\hat j\). If \(\vec c\) is a vector such that \(|\vec c|\ge6\), \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=6|\vec c|\), \(|\vec c-\vec a|=2\sqrt2\) and the angle between \(\vec a\times\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) is \(60^\circ\), then \(|(\vec a\times\vec b)\times\vec c|\) is equal to :
questions.sol: \(|\vec c|^2-12|\vec c|+30=0\), \(|\vec c|=6+\sqrt6\). \(|\vec a\times\vec b|=3\sqrt3\), so the answer is \(3\sqrt3\cdot\tfrac{\sqrt3}2(6+\sqrt6)\).

questions.q: The set of all \(\alpha\), for which the vectors \(\vec a=\alpha t\hat i+6\hat j-3\hat k\) and \(\vec b=t\hat i-2\hat j-2\alpha t\hat k\) are inclined at an obtuse angle for all \(t\in R\), is
questions.sol: \(\alpha t^2+6\alpha t-12<0\) for all \(t\): \(\alpha=0\) works, or \(\alpha<0\) with \(36\alpha^2+48\alpha<0\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=4\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b=11\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec c\) be a vector such that \((\vec a+\vec b)\times\vec c=\vec c\times(-2\vec a+3\vec b)\). If \((2\vec a+3\vec b)\cdot\vec c=1670\), then \(|\vec c|^2\) is equal to :
questions.sol: \((-\vec a+4\vec b)\times\vec c=\vec0\Rightarrow\vec c=\lambda(40,-3,3)\); \((41,-5,5)\cdot\vec c=1670\lambda\Rightarrow\lambda=1\).

questions.q: Let three vectors \(\vec a=\alpha\hat i+4\hat j+2\hat k\), \(\vec b=5\hat i+3\hat j+4\hat k\), \(\vec c=x\hat i+y\hat j+z\hat k\) form a triangle such that \(\vec c=\vec a-\vec b\) and the area of the triangle is \(5\sqrt6\). If \(\alpha\) is a positive real number, then \(|\vec c|^2\) is equal to:
questions.sol: \(|\vec a\times\vec b|^2=100+(10-4\alpha)^2+(3\alpha-20)^2=600\Rightarrow\alpha=8\); \(\vec c=(3,1,-2)\).

questions.q: Let \(\overrightarrow{OA}=2\vec a\), \(\overrightarrow{OB}=6\vec a+5\vec b\) and \(\overrightarrow{OC}=3\vec b\), where \(O\) is the origin. If the area of the parallelogram with adjacent sides \(\overrightarrow{OA}\) and \(\overrightarrow{OC}\) is \(15\) sq. units, then the area (in sq. units) of the quadrilateral \(OABC\) is equal to :
questions.sol: \(6|\vec a\times\vec b|=15\). Area \(=\tfrac12|\overrightarrow{OB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}|=\tfrac12|(6\vec a+5\vec b)\times(3\vec b-2\vec a)|=14|\vec a\times\vec b|\).

Let the values of the ordered pair \((\alpha,\beta)\), for which the area of the parallelogram of diagonals \(\vec a+\vec b\) and \(\vec b+\vec c\) is \(\dfrac{\sqrt{21}}2\), be \((\alpha_1,\beta_1)\) and \((\alpha_2,\beta_2)\). Then \(\alpha_1^2+\beta_1^2-\alpha_2\beta_2\) is equal to
questions.sol: Area \(=\tfrac12|(\vec a+\vec b)\times(\vec b+\vec c)|\); checking the integer pairs with \(\alpha\beta=-6\) leaves \((-3,2)\) and \((3,-2)\): \(9+4+6=19\).

questions.q: Let \(\overrightarrow{OA}=\vec a\), \(\overrightarrow{OB}=12\vec a+4\vec b\) and \(\overrightarrow{OC}=\vec b\), where \(O\) is the origin. questions.sol: \(\tfrac12|(12\vec a+4\vec b)\times(\vec b-\vec a)|=8|\vec a\times\vec b|\).

If \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=3\sqrt2\), then the value of \((\alpha^2+\beta^2)|\vec a\times\vec b|^2\) is equal to

If the points with position vectors \(\alpha\hat i+10\hat j+13\hat k\), \(6\hat i+11\hat j+11\hat k\), \(\dfrac92\hat i+\beta\hat j-8\hat k\) are collinear, then \((19\alpha-6\beta)^2\) is equal to
questions.sol: Proportional differences give \(\beta=\tfrac{41}2\), \(\alpha=\tfrac{117}{19}\): \(19\alpha-6\beta=-6\).

questions.q: Let \(O\) be the origin and the position vector of the point \(P\) be \(-\hat i-2\hat j+3\hat k\). If the position vectors of the points \(A,B\) and \(C\) are \(-2\hat i+\hat j-3\hat k\), \(2\hat i+4\hat j-2\hat k\) and \(-4\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k\) respectively, then the projection of the vector \(\overrightarrow{OP}\) on a vector perpendicular to the vectors \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) and \(\overrightarrow{AC}\) is
questions.sol: \(\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}\parallel(1,-2,2)\); \((-1,-2,3)\cdot\tfrac{(1,-2,2)}3=3\).

questions.sol: \(\vec c=\mu(\vec a+\vec b)=\mu(\lambda+3,0,1)\). The two dot conditions give \(\lambda=3,\ \mu=-1\): \(\vec c=(-6,0,-1)\), and \(\vec c\times(3,1,1)=(1,3,-6)\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i+4\hat j+2\hat k\), \(\vec b=3\hat i-2\hat j+7\hat k\) and \(\vec c=2\hat i-\hat j+4\hat k\). If a vector \(\vec d\) satisfies \(\vec d\times\vec b=\vec c\times\vec b\) and \(\vec d\cdot\vec a=24\), then \(|\vec d|^2\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec d=\vec c+\lambda\vec b\), \(6+9\lambda=24\): \(\vec d=(8,-5,18)\).

questions.sol: \((\vec a+2\vec b)\times(2\vec a-3\vec b)=-7\,\vec a\times\vec b\) and \(|\vec a\times\vec b|=3\sqrt2\): \(49\cdot18\).

questions.sol: \(\vec r=\vec c+t\vec a\) with \(\vec r\cdot\vec b=-2+7t=0\): \(\vec r=\tfrac17(11,0,-11)\).

questions.sol: Each corner triangle has area \(\tfrac13\cdot\tfrac23=\tfrac29\) of \(\Delta PQR\), so \(\Delta ABC\) has \(1-\tfrac69=\tfrac13\) of it.

questions.sol: Solving gives \(\vec b=-\tfrac13(2,2,1)\), so \(\vec a-6\vec b=(3,3,3)\).

questions.sol: \(\vec r=\vec c+\lambda\vec b\), \(\vec r\cdot\vec a=15+3\lambda=0\): \(\vec r=(2,-8,-1)\), \(\vec r\cdot\vec c=14+24-4\).

questions.sol: \(\vec r=\vec c+\lambda\vec b\), \(8+5\lambda=0\): \(\vec r=\tfrac15(17,-7,-1)\).

\((S_2)\) : \(\angle ACB=\cos^{-1}\left(\sqrt{\dfrac23}\right)\)
Then
questions.sol: \(\vec a+\vec b+\vec c=\vec0\): \((\vec a+\vec c)\times\vec b=\vec0\), and \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=-24\), \(|\vec c|=6\), so \(S_1\) gives \(-6\). \(\cos C=\tfrac{-\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec a||\vec b|}=\sqrt{\tfrac23}\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i-\hat j+2\hat k\) and let \(\vec b\) be a vector such that \(\vec a\times\vec b=2\hat i-\hat k\) and \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=3\). Then the projection of \(\vec b\) on the vector \(\vec a-\vec b\) is
questions.sol: \(\vec b=\tfrac{(\vec a\cdot\vec b)\vec a-\vec a\times(\vec a\times\vec b)}{|\vec a|^2}=\tfrac13(1,-4,2)\), \(\vec a-\vec b=\tfrac13(2,1,4)\). Projection \(\tfrac{6/9}{\sqrt{21}/3}\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\alpha\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\vec b=2\hat i+\hat j-\alpha\hat k\), \(\alpha>0\). If the projection of \(\vec a\times\vec b\) on the vector \(-\hat i+2\hat j-2\hat k\) is \(30\), then \(\alpha\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec a\times\vec b=(1-\alpha,\alpha^2-2,\alpha-2)\); projection \(\tfrac{2\alpha^2-\alpha-1}3=30\Rightarrow\alpha=7\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\alpha\hat i+\hat j+\beta\hat k\) and \(\vec b=3\hat i-5\hat j+4\hat k\) be two vectors, such that \(\vec a\times\vec b=-\hat i+9\hat j+12\hat k\). Then the projection of \(\vec b-2\vec a\) on \(\vec b+\vec a\) is equal to
Let \(\vec a=2\hat i-\hat j+5\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\alpha\hat i+\beta\hat j+2\hat k\). If \(((\vec a\times\vec b)\times\hat i)\cdot\hat k=\dfrac{23}2\), then \(|\vec b\times2\hat j|\) is equal to
questions.sol: \((\vec v\times\hat i)\cdot\hat k=-v_y=4-5\alpha=\tfrac{23}2\Rightarrow\alpha=-\tfrac32\). \(\vec b\times2\hat j=(-4,0,2\alpha)\).

questions.q: Let a vector \(\vec a\) has magnitude \(9\). Let a vector \(\vec b\) be such that for every \((x,y)\in R\times R-\{(0,0)\}\), the vector \((x\vec a+y\vec b)\) is perpendicular to the vector \((6y\vec a-18x\vec b)\). Then the value of \(|\vec a\times\vec b|\) is equal to
questions.sol: Expanding: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=0\) and \(6|\vec a|^2=18|\vec b|^2\), so \(|\vec b|=3\sqrt3\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=3\hat i+\hat j\) and \(\vec b=\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k\). Let \(\vec c\) be a vector satisfying \(\vec a\times(\vec b\times\vec c)=\vec b+\lambda\vec c\). If \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) are non-parallel, then the value of \(\lambda\) is
questions.sol: \((\vec a\cdot\vec c)\vec b-(\vec a\cdot\vec b)\vec c=\vec b+\lambda\vec c\): \(\lambda=-\vec a\cdot\vec b=-5\).

questions.q:
Let \(\hat a\) and \(\hat b\) be two unit vectors such that \(|(\hat a+\hat b)+2(\hat a\times\hat b)|=2\). If \(\theta\in(0,\pi)\) is the angle between \(\hat a\) and \(\hat b\), then among the statements
\((S_1)\) : \(2|\hat a\times\hat b|=|\hat a-\hat b|\)
\((S_2)\) : The projection of \(\hat a\) on \((\hat a+\hat b)\) is \(\dfrac12\)
questions.sol: \(2+2\cos\theta+4\sin^2\theta=4\Rightarrow\cos\theta=-\tfrac12\). Then \(2\sin\theta=\sqrt3=|\hat a-\hat b|\), and the projection is \(\tfrac{1/2}{1}\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) be the vectors along the diagonals of a parallelogram having area \(2\sqrt2\). Let the angle between \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) be acute, \(|\vec a|=1\), and \(|\vec a\cdot\vec b|=|\vec a\times\vec b|\). If \(\vec c=2\sqrt2(\vec a\times\vec b)-2\vec b\), then an angle between \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) is
questions.sol: \(\tfrac12|\vec a\times\vec b|=2\sqrt2\) and the angle is \(45^\circ\), so \(|\vec b|=8\). \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=-128\), \(|\vec c|^2=8\cdot32+4\cdot64=512\): \(\cos=-\tfrac1{\sqrt2}\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\alpha\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\vec b=-2\hat i+\alpha\hat j+\hat k\), where \(\alpha\in R\). If the area of the parallelogram whose adjacent sides are represented by the vectors \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) is \(\sqrt{15(\alpha^2+4)}\), then the value of \(2|\vec a|^2+(\vec a\cdot\vec b)|\vec b|^2\) is equal to

Let \(\vec a=\alpha\hat i+3\hat j-\hat k\), \(\vec b=3\hat i-\beta\hat j+4\hat k\) and \(\vec c=\hat i+2\hat j-2\hat k\) where \(\alpha,\beta\in\mathbf R\), be three vectors. If the projection of \(\vec a\) on \(\vec c\) is \(\dfrac{10}3\) and \(\vec b\times\vec c=-6\hat i+10\hat j+7\hat k\), then the value of \(\alpha+\beta\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\tfrac{\alpha+8}3=\tfrac{10}3\Rightarrow\alpha=2\); \(\vec b\times\vec c=(2\beta-8,10,6+\beta)\Rightarrow\beta=1\).

questions.q: If \(|\vec a|=2\), \(|\vec b|=5\) and \(|\vec a\times\vec b|=8\), then \(|\vec a\cdot\vec b|\) is equal to

Let \(\vec a=\hat i+2\hat j-3\hat k\) and \(\vec b=2\hat i-3\hat j+5\hat k\). If \(\vec r\times\vec a=\vec b\times\vec r\), \(\vec r\cdot(\alpha\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k)=3\) and \(\vec r\cdot(2\hat i+5\hat j-\alpha\hat k)=-1\), \(\alpha\in R\), then the value of \(\alpha+|\vec r|^2\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec r=\lambda(\vec a+\vec b)=\lambda(3,-1,2)\): \(3\lambda\alpha=3\) and \(\lambda(1-2\alpha)=-1\) give \(\lambda=\alpha=1\); \(|\vec r|^2=14\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=2\hat i-3\hat j+4\hat k\) and \(\vec b=7\hat i+\hat j-6\hat k\). If \(\vec r\times\vec a=\vec r\times\vec b\), \(\vec r\cdot(\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k)=-3\), then \(\vec r\cdot(2\hat i-3\hat j+\hat k)\) is equal to

Let \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) be three unit vectors such that \(\vec a+\vec b+\vec c=\vec0\). If \(\lambda=\vec a\cdot\vec b+\vec b\cdot\vec c+\vec c\cdot\vec a\) and \(\vec d=\vec a\times\vec b+\vec b\times\vec c+\vec c\times\vec a\), then the ordered pair, \((\lambda,\vec d)\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\lambda=-\tfrac32\). With \(\vec c=-(\vec a+\vec b)\): \(\vec b\times\vec c=\vec a\times\vec b\) and \(\vec c\times\vec a=\vec a\times\vec b\).

questions.q: The magnitude of the projection of the vector \(2\hat i+3\hat j+\hat k\) on the vector perpendicular to the plane containing the vectors \(\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k\), is

Let \(\vec\alpha=3\hat i+\hat j\) and \(\vec\beta=2\hat i-\hat j+3\hat k\). If \(\vec\beta=\vec\beta_1-\vec\beta_2\), where \(\vec\beta_1\) is parallel to \(\vec\alpha\) and \(\vec\beta_2\) is perpendicular to \(\vec\alpha\), then \(\vec\beta_1\times\vec\beta_2\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec\beta_1=\tfrac12\vec\alpha\), \(\vec\beta_2=\vec\beta_1-\vec\beta=\left(-\tfrac12,\tfrac32,-3\right)\); cross product \(\tfrac12(-3,9,5)\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=3\hat i+2\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\hat i+2\hat j-2\hat k\) be two vectors. If a vector perpendicular to both the vectors \(\vec a+\vec b\) and \(\vec a-\vec b\) has the magnitude \(12\) then one such vector is
questions.sol: \((\vec a+\vec b)\times(\vec a-\vec b)=-2\vec a\times\vec b\parallel(-2,2,1)\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) are unit vectors such that \(\vec a+2\vec b+2\vec c=0\), then \(|\vec a\times\vec c|\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(|2\vec b|^2=|\vec a+2\vec c|^2\Rightarrow4=5+4\vec a\cdot\vec c\), \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=-\tfrac14\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=2\hat i+\hat j-2\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\hat i+\hat j\). Let \(\vec c\) be a vector such that \(|\vec c-\vec a|=3\), \(|(\vec a\times\vec b)\times\vec c|=3\) and the angle between \(\vec c\) and \(\vec a\times\vec b\) be \(30^\circ\). Then \(\vec a\cdot\vec c\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(|\vec a\times\vec b|=3\), so \(|\vec c|\cdot3\cdot\tfrac12=3\), \(|\vec c|=2\). \(4+9-2\vec a\cdot\vec c=9\).

questions.q: If the vector \(\vec b=3\hat j+4\hat k\) is written as the sum of a vector \(\vec b_1\), parallel to \(\vec a=\hat i+\hat j\) and a vector \(\vec b_2\), perpendicular to \(\vec a\), then \(\vec b_1\times\vec b_2\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec b_1=\tfrac32(1,1,0)\), \(\vec b_2=\left(-\tfrac32,\tfrac32,4\right)\); cross product \(\left(6,-6,\tfrac92\right)\).

questions.q: The area (in sq. units) of the parallelogram whose diagonals are along the vectors \(8\hat i-6\hat j\) and \(3\hat i+4\hat j-12\hat k\), is
Let \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) be two unit vectors such that \(|\vec a+\vec b|=\sqrt3\). If \(\vec c=\vec a+2\vec b+3(\vec a\times\vec b)\), then \(2|\vec c|\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=\tfrac12\). \(|\vec c|^2=|\vec a+2\vec b|^2+9|\vec a\times\vec b|^2=7+\tfrac{27}4\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=2\hat i+\hat j-2\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat i+\hat j\). If \(\vec c\) is a vector such that \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=|\vec c|\), \(|\vec c-\vec a|=2\sqrt2\) and the angle between \(\vec a\times\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) is \(30^\circ\), then \(|(\vec a\times\vec b)\times\vec c|\) equals
questions.sol: \(|\vec c|^2+9-2|\vec c|=8\Rightarrow|\vec c|=1\); \(|\vec a\times\vec b|=3\): \(3\cdot\tfrac12\).

questions.q: If \(\vec u=\hat j+4\hat k\), \(\vec v=\hat i-3\hat k\), and \(\vec w=\cos\theta\hat i+\sin\theta\hat j\) are vectors in 3-dimensional space, then the maximum possible value of \(|\vec u\times\vec v\cdot\vec w|\) is
questions.sol: \(\vec u\times\vec v=(-3,4,-1)\), so the value is \(|-3\cos\theta+4\sin\theta|\le5\).

questions.q: If \(\hat u\) and \(\hat v\) are unit vectors and \(\theta\) is the acute angle between them, then \(2\hat u\times3\hat v\) is a unit vector for
questions.sol: \(6\sin\theta=1\) has one acute solution.

questions.q: For any vector \(\vec a\), the value of \((\vec a\times\hat i)^2+(\vec a\times\hat j)^2+(\vec a\times\hat k)^2\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\sum\left(|\vec a|^2-a_x^2\right)=3|\vec a|^2-|\vec a|^2\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec u=\hat i+\hat j\), \(\vec v=\hat i-\hat j\) and \(\vec w=\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k\). If \(\hat n\) is a unit vector such that \(\vec u\cdot\hat n=0\) and \(\vec v\cdot\hat n=0\), then \(|\vec w\cdot\hat n|\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\hat n=\pm\hat k\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a\times\vec b=\vec b\times\vec c=\vec c\times\vec a\), then \(\vec a+\vec b+\vec c=\)
questions.sol: \(\vec b\times(\vec a+\vec c)=\vec0\) and similarly for the others, so \(\vec a+\vec b+\vec c\) is parallel to each of \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\); for non-collinear vectors it is \(\vec0\).

questions.q: \(\vec a=3\hat i-5\hat j\) and \(\vec b=6\hat i+3\hat j\) are two vectors and \(\vec c\) is a vector such that \(\vec c=\vec a\times\vec b\) then \(|\vec a|:|\vec b|:|\vec c|=\)
\(3\lambda\vec c+2\mu(\vec a\times\vec b)=0\) then
questions.sol: If \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) are non-coplanar, \(\vec c\) and \(\vec a\times\vec b\) are independent and \(\lambda=\mu=0\), which satisfies every option; the book's answer is (b).

questions.q: If \(|\vec a|=4\), \(|\vec b|=2\) and the angle between \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) is \(\dfrac\pi6\) then \((\vec a\times\vec b)^2\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\left(4\cdot2\cdot\tfrac12\right)^2\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b=3\hat i-3\hat j+3\hat k\), \(\vec c=2\hat i-\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(\vec d\) be a vector such that \(\vec b\times\vec d=\vec c\times\vec d\) and \(\vec a\cdot\vec d=4\). Then \(|(\vec a\times\vec d)|^2\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec d=\lambda(\vec b-\vec c)=\lambda(1,-2,1)\), \(-2\lambda=4\): \(\vec d=(-2,4,-2)\); \(\vec a\times\vec d=(-8,0,8)\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec c\) be the projection vector of \(\vec b=\lambda\hat i+4\hat k\), \(\lambda>0\), on the vector \(\vec a=\hat i+2\hat j+2\hat k\). If \(|\vec a+\vec c|=7\), then the area of the parallelogram formed by the vectors \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) is ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec c=k\vec a\) with \(3(1+k)=7\), \(k=\tfrac43=\tfrac{\lambda+8}9\Rightarrow\lambda=4\). Area \(=k|\vec b\times\vec a|=\tfrac43|(-8,-4,8)|=16\).

questions.q: Let \(ABC\) be a triangle of area \(15\sqrt2\) and the vectors \(\overrightarrow{AB}=\hat i+2\hat j-7\hat k\), \(\overrightarrow{BC}=a\hat i+b\hat j+c\hat k\) and \(\overrightarrow{AC}=6\hat i+d\hat j-2\hat k\), \(d>0\). Then the square of the length of the largest side of the triangle \(ABC\) is ______.
questions.sol: \(|\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AC}|^2=(7d-4)^2+1600+(d-12)^2=1800\Rightarrow d=2\). Sides squared: \(54,\ 44,\ 50\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i-3\hat j+7\hat k\), \(\vec b=2\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec c\) be a vector such that \((\vec a+2\vec b)\times\vec c=3(\vec c\times\vec a)\). If \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=130\), then \(\vec b\cdot\vec c\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \((4\vec a+2\vec b)\times\vec c=\vec0\Rightarrow\vec c=\mu(4,-7,15)\), \(130\mu=130\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=2\hat i-3\hat j+4\hat k\), \(\vec b=3\hat i+4\hat j-5\hat k\) and a vector \(\vec c\) be such that \(\vec a\times(\vec b+\vec c)+\vec b\times\vec c=\hat i+8\hat j+13\hat k\). If \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=13\), then \((24-\vec b\cdot\vec c)\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec a\times\vec b=(-1,22,17)\), so \((\vec a+\vec b)\times\vec c=(2,-14,-4)\). With \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=13\): \(\vec c=(-1,-1,3)\), \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=-22\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=9\hat i-13\hat j+25\hat k\), \(\vec b=3\hat i+7\hat j-13\hat k\) and \(\vec c=17\hat i-2\hat j+\hat k\) be three given vectors. If \(\vec r\) is a vector such that \(\vec r\times\vec a=(\vec b+\vec c)\times\vec a\) and \(\vec r\cdot(\vec b-\vec c)=0\), then \(\dfrac{|593\vec r+67\vec a|^2}{(593)^2}\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec r=\vec b+\vec c+\lambda\vec a\); \(|\vec b|^2-|\vec c|^2+\lambda\vec a\cdot(\vec b-\vec c)=-67-593\lambda=0\). Then \(593\vec r+67\vec a=593(\vec b+\vec c)\) and \(|\vec b+\vec c|^2=569\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b=-\hat i-8\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(\vec c=4\hat i+c_2\hat j+c_3\hat k\) be three vectors such that \(\vec b\times\vec a=\vec c\times\vec a\). If the angle between the vector \(\vec c\) and the vector \(3\hat i+4\hat j+\hat k\) is \(\theta\), then the greatest integer less than or equal to \(\tan^2\theta\) is ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec c=\vec b+\lambda\vec a\) with \(\lambda=5\): \(\vec c=(4,-3,7)\). \(\cos^2\theta=\tfrac{49}{74\cdot26}\), so \(\tan^2\theta=\tfrac{1875}{49}\approx38.3\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) be two vectors such that \(|\vec a|=1\), \(|\vec b|=4\) and \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=2\). If \(\vec c=(2\vec a\times\vec b)-3\vec b\) and the angle between \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) is \(\alpha\), then \(192\sin^2\alpha\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=-48\), \(|\vec c|^2=4|\vec a\times\vec b|^2+144=192\). \(\cos^2\alpha=\tfrac{48^2}{16\cdot192}=\tfrac34\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=3\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b=2\hat i-\hat j+3\hat k\) and \(\vec c\) be a vector such that \((\vec a+\vec b)\times\vec c=2(\vec a\times\vec b)+24\hat j-6\hat k\) and \((\vec a-\vec b+\hat i)\cdot\vec c=-3\). Then \(|\vec c|^2\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec a\times\vec b=(7,-7,-7)\); solving \((5,1,4)\times\vec c=(14,10,-20)\) with the dot condition gives \(|\vec c|^2=38\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=6\hat i+9\hat j+12\hat k\), \(\vec b=\alpha\hat i+11\hat j-2\hat k\) and \(\vec c\) be vectors such that \(\vec a\times\vec c=\vec a\times\vec b\). If \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=-12\), \(\vec c\cdot(\hat i-2\hat j+\hat k)=5\), then \(\vec c\cdot(\hat i+\hat j+\hat k)\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec c=\vec b+t\vec a\); the two dot conditions fix \(\alpha\) and \(t\), giving \(\vec c\cdot(1,1,1)=11\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=3\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\vec c=2\hat i-3\hat j+3\hat k\). If \(\vec b\) is a vector such that \(\vec a=\vec b\times\vec c\) and \(|\vec b|^2=50\), then \(|72-|\vec b+\vec c|^2|\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=0\), and \(|\vec a|^2=|\vec b|^2|\vec c|^2-(\vec b\cdot\vec c)^2\Rightarrow11=50\cdot22-(\vec b\cdot\vec c)^2\), \((\vec b\cdot\vec c)^2=1089\), \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=\pm33\). \(|\vec b+\vec c|^2=72\pm66\).

questions.q: \(A(2,6,2)\), \(B(-4,0,\lambda)\), \(C(2,3,-1)\) and \(D(4,5,0)\), \(|\lambda|\le5\) are the vertices of a quadrilateral \(ABCD\). If its area is \(18\) square units, then \(|5-6\lambda|\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\tfrac12|\overrightarrow{AC}\times\overrightarrow{BD}|=18\Rightarrow\lambda=-1\) or \(-9\); take \(\lambda=-1\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i+2\hat j+\lambda\hat k\), \(\vec b=3\hat i-5\hat j-\lambda\hat k\), \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=7\), \(2\vec b\cdot\vec c+43=0\), \(\vec a\times\vec c=\vec b\times\vec c\). Then \(|\vec a\cdot\vec b|\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec c=t(\vec a-\vec b)=t(-2,7,2\lambda)\); the two dot conditions give \(t=\tfrac12\), \(\lambda^2=1\). Then \(|\vec a\cdot\vec b|=|3-10-\lambda^2|=8\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) be two vectors such that \(|\vec a|=\sqrt{14}\), \(|\vec b|=\sqrt6\) and \(|\vec a\times\vec b|=\sqrt{48}\). Then \((\vec a\cdot\vec b)^2\) is equal to ______.

Let \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) be three vectors such that \(|\vec a|=\sqrt{31}\), \(4|\vec b|=|\vec c|=2\) and \(2(\vec a\times\vec b)=3(\vec c\times\vec a)\). If the angle between \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) is \(\dfrac{2\pi}3\), then \(\left(\dfrac{\vec a\times\vec c}{\vec a\cdot\vec b}\right)^2\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec a\times(2\vec b+3\vec c)=\vec0\Rightarrow\vec a=k(2\vec b+3\vec c)\), \(|2\vec b+3\vec c|^2=31\Rightarrow k=\pm1\). \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=-k\), \(|\vec a\times\vec c|^2=4|\vec b\times\vec c|^2=3\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) be three non-coplanar vectors such that \(\vec a\times\vec b=4\vec c\), \(\vec b\times\vec c=9\vec a\) and \(\vec c\times\vec a=\alpha\vec b\), \(\alpha>0\). If \(|\vec a|+|\vec b|+|\vec c|=\dfrac1{36}\), then \(\alpha\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: The vectors are mutually perpendicular and the first two relations give \(|\vec b|=6\), so \(|\vec a|+|\vec b|+|\vec c|>6\) — the data are inconsistent. NTA dropped this question (bonus).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) be two vectors such that \(|\vec a+\vec b|^2=|\vec a|^2+2|\vec b|^2\), \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=3\) and \(|\vec a\times\vec b|^2=75\). Then \(|\vec a|^2\) is equal to ______.

Let \(\theta\) be the angle between the vectors \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\), where \(|\vec a|=4\), \(|\vec b|=3\) and \(\theta\in\left(\dfrac\pi4,\dfrac\pi3\right)\). Then \(|(\vec a-\vec b)\times(\vec a+\vec b)|^2+4(\vec a\cdot\vec b)^2\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \((\vec a-\vec b)\times(\vec a+\vec b)=2\vec a\times\vec b\): total \(4\left(|\vec a\times\vec b|^2+(\vec a\cdot\vec b)^2\right)=4\cdot144\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec b=\hat i+\hat j+\lambda\hat k\), \(\lambda\in R\). If \(\vec a\) is a vector such that \(\vec a\times\vec b=13\hat i-\hat j-4\hat k\) and \(\vec a\cdot\vec b+21=0\), then \((\vec b-\vec a)\cdot(\hat k-\hat j)+(\vec b+\vec a)\cdot(\hat i-\hat k)\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \((13,-1,-4)\perp\vec b\Rightarrow\lambda=3\). \(\vec a=\tfrac{\vec b\times(\vec a\times\vec b)+(\vec a\cdot\vec b)\vec b}{|\vec b|^2}=(-2,2,-7)\). Then \(11+3=14\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i-2\hat j+3\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec c\) be a vector such that \(\vec a+(\vec b\times\vec c)=\vec0\) and \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=5\). Then, the value of \(3(\vec c\cdot\vec a)\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec b\times\vec c=-\vec a\) requires \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=0\), but \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=2\): no such \(\vec c\). NTA dropped this question (bonus).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=2\hat i-\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k\). Let a vector \(\vec v\) be in the plane containing \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\). If \(\vec v\) is perpendicular to the vector \(3\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k\) and its projection on \(\vec a\) is \(19\) units, then \(|2\vec v|^2\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec v=x\vec a+y\vec b\): \(2x+8y=0\) and \(\tfrac{9x-2y}3=19\) give \(x=6,\ y=-\tfrac32\). \(\vec v=\left(\tfrac{21}2,-9,\tfrac{27}2\right)\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i+5\hat j+\alpha\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat i+3\hat j+\beta\hat k\) and \(\vec c=-\hat i+2\hat j-3\hat k\) be three vectors such that, \(|\vec b\times\vec c|=5\sqrt3\) and \(\vec a\) is perpendicular to \(\vec b\). Then the greatest amongst the values of \(|\vec a|^2\) is ______.
questions.sol: \(14(10+\beta^2)-(5-3\beta)^2=75\Rightarrow\beta=-2,-4\); \(\alpha\beta=-16\Rightarrow\alpha=8,4\). Max \(26+64\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec p=2\hat i+3\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec q=\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k\) be two vectors. If a vector \(\vec r=(\alpha\hat i+\beta\hat j+\gamma\hat k)\) is perpendicular to each of the vectors \((\vec p+\vec q)\) and \((\vec p-\vec q)\), and \(|\vec r|=\sqrt3\), then \(|\alpha|+|\beta|+|\gamma|\) is equal to ______.

Let \(\vec a=\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat i-\hat j\) and \(\vec c=\hat i-\hat j-\hat k\) be three given vectors. If \(\vec r\) is a vector such that \(\vec r\times\vec a=\vec c\times\vec a\) and \(\vec r\cdot\vec b=0\), then \(\vec r\cdot\vec a\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec r=\vec c+\lambda\vec a\), \(\vec r\cdot\vec b=2-\lambda=0\): \(\vec r=(3,3,-3)\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i+\alpha\hat j+3\hat k\) and \(\vec b=3\hat i-\alpha\hat j+\hat k\). If the area of the parallelogram whose adjacent sides are represented by the vectors \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) is \(8\sqrt3\) square units, then \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec a\times\vec b=(4\alpha,8,-4\alpha)\): \(32\alpha^2+64=192\Rightarrow\alpha^2=4\). \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=6-\alpha^2\).

questions.q: Let the position vectors of points '\(A\)' and '\(B\)' be \(\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\) and \(2\hat i+\hat j+3\hat k\), respectively. A point '\(P\)' divides the line segment \(AB\) internally in the ratio \(\lambda:1\) \((\lambda>0)\). If \(O\) is the origin and \(\overrightarrow{OB}\cdot\overrightarrow{OP}-3|\overrightarrow{OA}\times\overrightarrow{OP}|^2=6\), then \(\lambda\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(P=\tfrac{(2\lambda+1,\lambda+1,3\lambda+1)}{\lambda+1}\); substituting and simplifying gives \(\lambda=\tfrac45\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) be three vectors such that \(|\vec a|=\sqrt3\), \(|\vec b|=5\), \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=10\) and the angle between \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) is \(\dfrac\pi3\). If \(\vec a\) is perpendicular to the vector \(\vec b\times\vec c\), then \(|\vec a\times(\vec b\times\vec c)|\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(|\vec c|=4\), \(|\vec b\times\vec c|=10\sqrt3\); since \(\vec a\perp\vec b\times\vec c\), the answer is \(\sqrt3\cdot10\sqrt3\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k\), \(\vec b=3\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\vec c\) be three vectors such that \(\vec c\) is coplanar with \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\). If the vector \(\vec c\) is perpendicular to \(\vec b\) and \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=5\), then \(|\vec c|\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec c=x\vec a+y\vec b\): \(2x+11y=0\), \(14x+2y=5\), giving \(\vec c=\tfrac16(1,4,7)\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b=2\hat i+4\hat j-5\hat k\) and \(\vec c=x\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k\), \(x\in R\). If \(\vec d\) is the unit vector in the direction of \(\vec b+\vec c\) such that \(\vec a\cdot\vec d=1\), then \((\vec a\times\vec b)\cdot\vec c\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec b+\vec c=(2+x,6,-2)\): \((x+6)^2=(x+2)^2+40\Rightarrow x=1\). \([\vec a\,\vec b\,\vec c]=\begin{vmatrix}1&1&1\\2&4&-5\\1&2&3\end{vmatrix}=11\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=-5\hat i+\hat j-3\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat i+2\hat j-4\hat k\) and \(\vec c=(((\vec a\times\vec b)\times\hat i)\times\hat i)\times\hat i\). Then \(\vec c\cdot(-\hat i+\hat j+\hat k)\) is equal to :
questions.sol: \(\vec a\times\vec b=(2,-23,-11)\); crossing with \(\hat i\) three times: \((0,-11,23)\to(0,23,11)\to(0,11,-23)\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b=3(\hat i-\hat j+\hat k)\). Let \(\vec c\) be the vector such that \(\vec a\times\vec c=\vec b\) and \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=3\). Then \(\vec a\cdot((\vec c\times\vec b)-\vec b-\vec c)\) is equal to :
questions.sol: \(\vec a\cdot(\vec c\times\vec b)=(\vec a\times\vec c)\cdot\vec b=|\vec b|^2=27\), \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=0\), \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=3\): \(27-0-3\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=a_1\hat i+a_2\hat j+a_3\hat k\) and \(\vec b=b_1\hat i+b_2\hat j+b_3\hat k\) be two vectors such that \(|\vec a|=1\), \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=2\) and \(|\vec b|=4\). If \(\vec c=2(\vec a\times\vec b)-3\vec b\), then the angle between \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=-48\), \(|\vec c|=\sqrt{4\cdot12+144}=8\sqrt3\): \(\cos=\tfrac{-48}{32\sqrt3}=-\tfrac{\sqrt3}2\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) be two vectors such that \(|\vec b|=1\) and \(|\vec b\times\vec a|=2\). Then \(|(\vec b\times\vec a)-\vec b|^2\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec b\times\vec a\perp\vec b\): \(4+1\).

questions.q: Let the position vectors of the points \(A,B,C\) and \(D\) be \(5\hat i+5\hat j+2\lambda\hat k\), \(\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k\), \(-2\hat i+\lambda\hat j+4\hat k\) and \(-\hat i+5\hat j+6\hat k\). Let the set \(S=\{\lambda\in\mathbb R:\) the points \(A,B,C\) and \(D\) are coplanar\(\}\). Then \(\displaystyle\sum_{\lambda\in S}(\lambda+2)^2\) is equal to
questions.sol: \([\overrightarrow{AB}\,\overrightarrow{AC}\,\overrightarrow{AD}]=0\) gives \(\lambda=2,3\): \(16+25\).

questions.q: Let the vectors \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) represent three coterminous edges of a parallelopiped of volume \(V\). Then the volume of the parallelopiped, whose coterminous edges are represented by \(\vec a,\vec b+\vec c\) and \(\vec a+2\vec b+3\vec c\) is equal to
questions.sol: \([\vec a,\vec b+\vec c,\vec a+2\vec b+3\vec c]=3[\vec a\vec b\vec c]+2[\vec a\vec c\vec b]=[\vec a\vec b\vec c]\).

questions.q: The sum of all values of \(\alpha\), for which the points whose position vectors are \(\hat i-2\hat j+3\hat k\), \(2\hat i-3\hat j+4\hat k\), \((\alpha+1)\hat i+2\hat k\) and \(9\hat i+(\alpha-8)\hat j+6\hat k\) are coplanar, is equal to
questions.sol: The coplanarity determinant vanishes for \(\alpha=-2,4\).

questions.q: Let the vectors \(\vec u_1=\hat i+\hat j+a\hat k\), \(\vec u_2=\hat i+b\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec u_3=c\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\) be coplanar. If the vectors \(\vec v_1=(a+b)\hat i+c\hat j+c\hat k\), \(\vec v_2=a\hat i+(b+c)\hat j+a\hat k\) and \(\vec v_3=b\hat i+b\hat j+(c+a)\hat k\) are also coplanar, then \(6(a+b+c)\) is equal to
questions.sol: The second determinant equals \(4abc=0\); the first gives \(a+b+c-2-abc=0\), so \(a+b+c=2\).

questions.q: If four distinct points with position vectors \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) and \(\vec d\) are coplanar, then \([\vec a\ \vec b\ \vec c]\) is equal to
opts: \([\vec b\ \vec c\ \vec d]+[\vec d\ \vec a\ \vec c]+[\vec d\ \vec b\ \vec a]\)
\([\vec d\ \vec c\ \vec a]+[\vec b\ \vec d\ \vec a]+[\vec c\ \vec d\ \vec b]\)
\([\vec d\ \vec b\ \vec a]+[\vec a\ \vec c\ \vec d]+[\vec d\ \vec b\ \vec c]\)
\([\vec a\ \vec d\ \vec b]+[\vec d\ \vec c\ \vec a]+[\vec d\ \vec b\ \vec c]\)
questions.sol: Expand \([\vec b-\vec a,\ \vec c-\vec a,\ \vec d-\vec a]=0\): \([\vec a\vec b\vec c]=[\vec b\vec c\vec d]-[\vec a\vec c\vec d]+[\vec a\vec b\vec d]\), which rearranges cyclically to option (b).

questions.q: Let \(a,b,c\) be three distinct real numbers, none equal to one. If the vectors \(a\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\), \(\hat i+b\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\hat i+\hat j+c\hat k\) are coplanar, then \(\dfrac1{1-a}+\dfrac1{1-b}+\dfrac1{1-c}\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(R_1-R_2\), \(R_2-R_3\) and dividing by \((1-a)(1-b)(1-c)\) in the determinant gives \(\sum\tfrac1{1-a}=1\).

questions.q: Let \(S\) be the set of all \((\lambda,\mu)\) for which the vectors \(\lambda\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\), \(\hat i+2\hat j+\mu\hat k\) and \(3\hat i-4\hat j+5\hat k\), where \(\lambda-\mu=5\), are coplanar, then \(\displaystyle\sum_{(\lambda,\mu)\in S}80(\lambda^2+\mu^2)\) is equal to
questions.sol: The determinant with \(\mu=\lambda-5\) gives \((\lambda,\mu)=(2,-3),\left(\tfrac54,-\tfrac{15}4\right)\): \(80\left(13+\tfrac{250}{16}\right)\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec u=\hat i-\hat j-2\hat k\), \(\vec v=2\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\), \(\vec v\cdot\vec w=2\) and \(\vec v\times\vec w=\vec u+\lambda\vec v\). Then \(\vec u\cdot\vec w\) is equal to
questions.sol: Dotting with \(\vec v\): \(0=\vec u\cdot\vec v+6\lambda=3+6\lambda\). Dotting with \(\vec w\): \(0=\vec u\cdot\vec w+2\lambda\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) be three non zero vectors such that \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=0\) and \(\vec a\times(\vec b\times\vec c)=\dfrac{\vec b-\vec c}2\). If \(\vec d\) be a vector such that \(\vec b\cdot\vec d=\vec a\cdot\vec b\), then \((\vec a\times\vec b)\cdot(\vec c\times\vec d)\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=\vec a\cdot\vec b=\tfrac12\). \((\vec a\cdot\vec c)(\vec b\cdot\vec d)-(\vec a\cdot\vec d)(\vec b\cdot\vec c)=\tfrac14\).

questions.q: If the four points, whose position vectors are \(3\hat i-4\hat j+2\hat k\), \(\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k\), \(-2\hat i-\hat j+3\hat k\) and \(5\hat i-2\alpha\hat j+4\hat k\) are coplanar, then \(\alpha\) is equal to
questions.sol: Setting the scalar triple product of the three difference vectors to zero gives \(\alpha=\tfrac{73}{17}\).

questions.q: If the vectors \(\vec a=\lambda\hat i+\mu\hat j+4\hat k\), \(\vec b=-2\hat i+4\hat j-2\hat k\) and \(\vec c=2\hat i+3\hat j+\hat k\) are coplanar and the projection of \(\vec a\) on the vector \(\vec b\) is \(\sqrt{54}\) units, then the sum of all possible values of \(\lambda+\mu\) is equal to
questions.sol: Coplanarity: \(10\lambda-2\mu=56\). Projection: \(\tfrac{|-2\lambda+4\mu-8|}{\sqrt{24}}=\sqrt{54}\Rightarrow-2\lambda+4\mu-8=\pm36\). The two solutions give \(\lambda+\mu=0\) and \(24\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=4\hat i+3\hat j\) and \(\vec b=3\hat i-4\hat j+5\hat k\). If \(\vec c\) is a vector such that \(\vec c\cdot(\vec a\times\vec b)+25=0\), \(\vec c\cdot(\hat i+\hat j+\hat k)=4\), and projection of \(\vec c\) on \(\vec a\) is \(1\), then the projection of \(\vec c\) on \(\vec b\) equals
questions.sol: Solving the three linear conditions gives \(\vec c\) with \(\vec c\cdot\vec b=25\); divide by \(|\vec b|=5\sqrt2\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) are three non-zero vectors and \(\hat n\) is a unit vector perpendicular to \(\vec c\) such that \(\vec a=\alpha\vec b-\hat n\), \((\alpha\ne0)\) and \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=12\), then \(|\vec c\times(\vec a\times\vec b)|\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec c\times(\vec a\times\vec b)=(\vec c\cdot\vec b)\vec a-(\vec c\cdot\vec a)\vec b=12\vec a-12\alpha\vec b=-12\hat n\).

questions.q: Let \(\lambda\in R\), \(\vec a=\lambda\hat i+2\hat j-3\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat i-\lambda\hat j+2\hat k\). If \(((\vec a+\vec b)\times(\vec a\times\vec b))\times(\vec a-\vec b)=8\hat i-40\hat j-24\hat k\), then \(|\lambda(\vec a-\vec b)\times(\vec a+\vec b)|^2\) is equal to
questions.sol: The given identity forces \(\lambda=1\). Then \((\vec a-\vec b)\times(\vec a+\vec b)=(0,3,-5)\times(2,1,-1)=(2,-10,-6)\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) be two vectors, Let \(|\vec a|=1\), \(|\vec b|=4\) and \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=2\). If \(\vec c=(2\vec a\times\vec b)-3\vec b\), then the value of \(\vec b\cdot\vec c\) is
questions.sol: \(\vec b\cdot(\vec a\times\vec b)=0\), so \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=-3\cdot16\).

questions.q: Let the vectors \(\vec a=(1+t)\hat i+(1-t)\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b=(1-t)\hat i+(1+t)\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(\vec c=t\hat i-t\hat j+\hat k\), \(t\in R\) be such that for \(\alpha,\beta,\gamma\in R\), \(\alpha\vec a+\beta\vec b+\gamma\vec c=\vec0\Rightarrow\alpha=\beta=\gamma=0\). Then, the set of all values of \(t\) is :
questions.sol: The vectors are independent iff \([\vec a\vec b\vec c]=6t\ne0\).

questions.q: If \((2,3,9),(5,2,1),(1,\lambda,8)\) and \((\lambda,2,3)\) are coplanar, then the product of all possible values of \(\lambda\) is
questions.sol: The coplanarity condition is a quadratic \(8\lambda^2-57\lambda+95=0\); product of roots \(\tfrac{95}8\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) be three coplanar concurrent vectors such that angles between any two of them is same. If the product of their magnitudes is \(14\) and \((\vec a\times\vec b)\cdot(\vec b\times\vec c)+(\vec b\times\vec c)\cdot(\vec c\times\vec a)+(\vec c\times\vec a)\cdot(\vec a\times\vec b)=168\), then \(|\vec a|+|\vec b|+|\vec c|\) is equal
questions.sol: The common angle is \(120^\circ\); each term equals \(\tfrac34|\vec a||\vec b||\vec c|\times\)(the repeated magnitude), so the sum is \(\tfrac34\cdot14\cdot(|\vec a|+|\vec b|+|\vec c|)=168\).

questions.q: Let \(\hat a,\hat b\) be unit vectors. If \(\vec c\) be a vector such that the angle between \(\hat a\) and \(\vec c\) is \(\dfrac\pi{12}\), and \(\hat b=\vec c+2(\vec c\times\hat a)\), then \(|6\vec c|^2\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(1=|\vec c|^2\left(1+4\sin^2\tfrac\pi{12}\right)=|\vec c|^2(3-\sqrt3)\); \(36|\vec c|^2=\tfrac{36}{3-\sqrt3}\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=1\), \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=2\) and \(\vec c\cdot\vec a=3\), then the value of \([\vec a\times(\vec b\times\vec c),\ \vec b\times(\vec c\times\vec a),\ \vec c\times(\vec b\times\vec a)]\) is
questions.sol: The three vectors are \(3\vec b-\vec c\), \(\vec c-2\vec a\), \(3\vec b-2\vec a\); their coefficient determinant is \(0\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i+\hat j+2\hat k\), \(\vec b=2\hat i-3\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec c=\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\) be three given vectors. Let \(\vec v\) be a vector in the plane of \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) whose projection on \(\vec c\) is \(\dfrac2{\sqrt3}\). If \(\vec v\cdot\hat j=7\), then \(\vec v\cdot(\hat i+\hat k)\) is equal to
Let \(\vec a=\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\vec c=2\hat i-3\hat j+2\hat k\). Then the number of vectors \(\vec b\) such that \(\vec b\times\vec c=\vec a\) and \(|\vec b|\in\{1,2,\dots,10\}\) is
questions.sol: \(\vec b\times\vec c=\vec a\) needs \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=0\), but \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=-3\).

questions.q: Let \(A,B,C\) be three points whose position vectors respectively are \(\vec a=\hat i+4\hat j+3\hat k\); \(\vec b=2\hat i+\alpha\hat j+4\hat k\), \(\alpha\in\mathbb R\); \(\vec c=3\hat i-2\hat j+5\hat k\). If \(\alpha\) is the smallest positive integer for which \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) are noncollinear, then the length of the median, in \(\Delta ABC\), through \(A\) is
questions.sol: \(\alpha=1\) makes \(A,B,C\) collinear, so \(\alpha=2\). Midpoint of \(BC\): \(\left(\tfrac52,0,\tfrac92\right)\); median length \(\sqrt{\tfrac94+16+\tfrac94}\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\hat j-\hat k\). If \(\vec c\) is a vector such that \(\vec a\times\vec c=\vec b\) and \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=3\), then \(\vec a\cdot(\vec b\times\vec c)\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec a\cdot(\vec b\times\vec c)=-\vec b\cdot(\vec a\times\vec c)=-|\vec b|^2\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) be three vectors mutually perpendicular to each other and have same magnitude. If a vector \(\vec r\) satisfies \(\vec a\times\{(\vec r-\vec b)\times\vec a\}+\vec b\times\{(\vec r-\vec c)\times\vec b\}+\vec c\times\{(\vec r-\vec a)\times\vec c\}=\vec0\), then \(\vec r\) is equal to
questions.sol: With \(|\vec a|^2=k\): each term is \(k(\vec r-\vec b)-(\vec a\cdot\vec r)\vec a\) etc. Summing: \(3k\vec r-k\vec r-k(\vec a+\vec b+\vec c)=\vec0\).

questions.sol: \(|\vec c|=1\), \(|\vec a\times\vec b|=3\): \(3\cdot1\cdot\tfrac12\).

questions.q: Let three vectors \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) be such that \(\vec a\times\vec b=\vec c\), \(\vec b\times\vec c=\vec a\) and \(|\vec a|=2\). Then, which one of the following is not true?

questions.q: Let the vectors \((2+a+b)\hat i+(a+2b+c)\hat j-(b+c)\hat k\), \((1+b)\hat i+2b\hat j-b\hat k\) and \((2+b)\hat i+2b\hat j+(1-b)\hat k\), \(a,b,c\in R\) be co-planar. Then which of the following is true?

questions.sol: \(\begin{vmatrix}a&a&c\\1&0&1\\c&c&b\end{vmatrix}=c^2-ab=0\).

questions.sol: Direct computation gives \((238,-35,21)=7(34,-5,3)\).

questions.sol: \(\vec a=(\vec b\cdot\vec c)\vec b-\vec c\): \(2=4\cos^2\theta+4-8\cos^2\theta\Rightarrow\cos^2\theta=\tfrac12\).

If \(\overrightarrow{OR}=3\hat i+z\hat j-7\hat k\), \(z\in R\), is coplanar with \(\overrightarrow{OP}\) and \(\overrightarrow{OQ}\), then the value of \(x^2+y^2+z^2\) is equal to

questions.sol: \(|\vec a|=|\vec b|=1\) and the three vectors are orthonormal: \(\cos=\tfrac1{\sqrt3}\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) are perpendicular, then \(\vec a\times(\vec a\times(\vec a\times(\vec a\times\vec b)))\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec a\times(\vec a\times\vec b)=-|\vec a|^2\vec b\); applying twice gives \(|\vec a|^4\vec b\).

questions.q: Let \(x_0\) be the point of local maxima of \(f(x)=\vec a\cdot(\vec b\times\vec c)\), where \(\vec a=x\hat i-2\hat j+3\hat k\), \(\vec b=-2\hat i+x\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\vec c=7\hat i-2\hat j+x\hat k\). Then the value of \(\vec a\cdot\vec b+\vec b\cdot\vec c+\vec c\cdot\vec a\) at \(x=x_0\) is
questions.sol: \(f(x)=x^3-27x+26\), local maximum at \(x=-3\). Then \(\vec a\cdot\vec b+\vec b\cdot\vec c+\vec c\cdot\vec a=-22\).

questions.q: If the volume of a parallelopiped, whose coterminus edges are given by the vectors \(\vec a=\hat i+\hat j+n\hat k\), \(\vec b=2\hat i+4\hat j-n\hat k\) and \(\vec c=\hat i+n\hat j+3\hat k\) \((n\ge0)\), is \(158\) cu. units, then
questions.sol: \([\vec a\vec b\vec c]=3n^2-5n+6=158\Rightarrow n=8\); \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=2+32-24=10\).

questions.q: Let the volume of a parallelopiped whose coterminous edges are given by \(\vec u=\hat i+\hat j+\lambda\hat k\), \(\vec v=\hat i+\hat j+3\hat k\) and \(\vec w=2\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\) be \(1\) cu. unit. If \(\theta\) be the angle between the edges \(\vec u\) and \(\vec w\), then \(\cos\theta\) can be
questions.sol: \(|\lambda-3|=1\Rightarrow\lambda=2,4\). For \(\lambda=4\): \(\cos\theta=\tfrac7{\sqrt{18}\sqrt6}\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i-2\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\) be two vectors. If \(\vec c\) is a vector such that \(\vec b\times\vec c=\vec b\times\vec a\) and \(\vec c\cdot\vec a=0\), then \(\vec c\cdot\vec b\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec c=\vec a+t\vec b\), \(6+4t=0\): \(\vec c\cdot\vec b=4+3t=-\tfrac12\).

questions.q: If the volume of parallelopiped formed by the vectors \(\hat i+\lambda\hat j+\hat k\), \(\hat j+\lambda\hat k\) and \(\lambda\hat i+\hat k\) is minimum, then \(\lambda\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(V(\lambda)=\lambda^3-\lambda+1\) has its local minimum at \(\lambda=\tfrac1{\sqrt3}\).

questions.q: Let \(\alpha\in R\) and the three vectors \(\vec a=\alpha\hat i+\hat j+3\hat k\), \(\vec b=2\hat i+\hat j-\alpha\hat k\) and \(\vec c=\alpha\hat i-2\hat j+3\hat k\). Then the set \(S=\{\alpha:\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) are coplanar\(\}\)
