questions.sol: The determinant is \(-3(\alpha^2+6)\ne0\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i-\hat j\), \(\vec b=\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec c\) be a vector such that \(\vec a\times\vec c+\vec b=\vec0\) and \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=4\) then \(|\vec c|^2\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec a\times(\vec a\times\vec c)=-\vec a\times\vec b\Rightarrow4\vec a-2\vec c=-\vec a\times\vec b\), so \(\vec c=\tfrac12(4\vec a+\vec a\times\vec b)=\left(\tfrac32,-\tfrac52,1\right)\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i+2\hat j+4\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat i+\lambda\hat j+4\hat k\) and \(\vec c=2\hat i+4\hat j+(\lambda^2-1)\hat k\) be coplanar vectors. Then the non-zero vector \(\vec a\times\vec c\) is
questions.sol: The determinant gives \(\lambda=2,\pm3\); \(\lambda=\pm3\) makes \(\vec c\parallel\vec a\). With \(\lambda=2\): \(\vec a\times(2,4,3)=(-10,5,0)\).

questions.q: The sum of the distinct real values of \(\mu\), for which the vectors, \(\mu\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\), \(\hat i+\mu\hat j+\hat k\), \(\hat i+\hat j+\mu\hat k\) are co-planar, is

Let \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) be three unit vectors, out of which vectors \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) are non-parallel. If \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\) are the angles which vector \(\vec a\) makes with vectors \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) respectively and \(\vec a\times(\vec b\times\vec c)=\dfrac12\vec b\), then \(|\alpha-\beta|\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=\tfrac12\), \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=0\): \(\alpha=90^\circ\), \(\beta=60^\circ\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec u\) be a vector coplanar with the vectors \(\vec a=2\hat i+3\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\hat j+\hat k\). If \(\vec u\) is perpendicular to \(\vec a\) and \(\vec u\cdot\vec b=24\), then \(|\vec u|^2\) is equal to
Let \(\vec a=\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec c=\hat j-\hat k\) and a vector \(\vec b\) be such that \(\vec a\times\vec b=\vec c\) and \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=3\). Then \(|\vec b|\) equals :
questions.sol: \(|\vec b|^2=\tfrac{|\vec a\times\vec b|^2+(\vec a\cdot\vec b)^2}{|\vec a|^2}=\tfrac{2+9}3\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) be three unit vectors such that \(\vec a\times(\vec b\times\vec c)=\dfrac{\sqrt3}2(\vec b+\vec c)\). If \(\vec b\) is not parallel to \(\vec c\), then the angle between \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) is
questions.sol: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=-\tfrac{\sqrt3}2\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) be three non-zero vectors such that no two of them are collinear and \((\vec a\times\vec b)\times\vec c=\dfrac13|\vec b||\vec c|\vec a\). If \(\theta\) is the angle between vectors \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\), then a value of \(\sin\theta\) is
questions.sol: \((\vec a\cdot\vec c)\vec b-(\vec b\cdot\vec c)\vec a=\tfrac13|\vec b||\vec c|\vec a\) gives \(\cos\theta=-\tfrac13\).

questions.q: If \([\vec a\times\vec b\ \ \vec b\times\vec c\ \ \vec c\times\vec a]=\lambda[\vec a\ \vec b\ \vec c]^2\), then \(\lambda\) is equal to
questions.sol: Standard identity: \([\vec a\times\vec b,\vec b\times\vec c,\vec c\times\vec a]=[\vec a\vec b\vec c]^2\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a=\dfrac1{\sqrt{10}}(3\hat i+\hat k)\) and \(\vec b=\dfrac17(2\hat i+3\hat j-6\hat k)\), then the value of \((2\vec a-\vec b)\cdot[(\vec a\times\vec b)\times(\vec a+2\vec b)]\) is
questions.sol: \(\vec a,\vec b\) are perpendicular unit vectors, so \((\vec a\times\vec b)\times(\vec a+2\vec b)=\vec b-2\vec a\). Then \((2\vec a-\vec b)\cdot(\vec b-2\vec a)=-|2\vec a-\vec b|^2=-5\).

questions.q: The vectors \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) are not perpendicular and \(\vec c\) and \(\vec d\) are two vectors satisfying : \(\vec b\times\vec c=\vec b\times\vec d\) and \(\vec a\cdot\vec d=0\). Then the vector \(\vec d\) is equal to

\(\vec c-\left(\dfrac{\vec a\cdot\vec c}{\vec a\cdot\vec b}\right)\vec b\)
\(\vec b-\left(\dfrac{\vec b\cdot\vec c}{\vec a\cdot\vec b}\right)\vec c\)
\(\vec c+\left(\dfrac{\vec a\cdot\vec c}{\vec a\cdot\vec b}\right)\vec b\)
questions.sol: \(\vec d=\vec c+t\vec b\) and \(\vec a\cdot\vec d=0\Rightarrow t=-\tfrac{\vec a\cdot\vec c}{\vec a\cdot\vec b}\).

If \(\vec u,\vec v,\vec w\) are non-coplanar vectors and \(p,q\) are real numbers, then the equality \([3\vec u\ p\vec v\ p\vec w]-[p\vec v\ \vec w\ q\vec u]-[2\vec w\ q\vec v\ q\vec u]=0\) holds for
opts: more than two but not all values of \((p,q)\)
questions.sol: The left side is \((3p^2-pq+2q^2)[\vec u\vec v\vec w]\), zero only for \(p=q=0\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat i-\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(\vec c=x\hat i+(x-2)\hat j-\hat k\). If the vectors lies in the plane of \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\), then \(x\) equals
questions.sol: \([\vec a\vec b\vec c]=0\Rightarrow x=-2\).

questions.q: If \((\vec a\times\vec b)\times\vec c=\vec a\times(\vec b\times\vec c)\), where \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) are any three vectors such that \(\vec a\cdot\vec b\ne0\), \(\vec b\cdot\vec c\ne0\), then \(\vec a\) and \(\vec c\) are
opts: inclined at an angle of \(\pi/3\) between them
inclined at an angle of \(\pi/6\) between them
questions.sol: The equation reduces to \((\vec b\cdot\vec c)\vec a=(\vec a\cdot\vec b)\vec c\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) are non-coplanar vectors and \(\lambda\) is a real number then \([\lambda(\vec a+\vec b)\ \ \lambda^2\vec b\ \ \lambda\vec c]=[\vec a\ \ \vec b+\vec c\ \ \vec b]\) for
questions.sol: Left side \(\lambda^4[\vec a\vec b\vec c]\), right side \(-[\vec a\vec b\vec c]\): \(\lambda^4=-1\) has no real solution.

questions.q: Let \(a,b\) and \(c\) be distinct non-negative numbers. If the vectors \(a\hat i+a\hat j+c\hat k\), \(\hat i+\hat k\) and \(c\hat i+c\hat j+b\hat k\) lie in a plane, then \(c\) is
questions.sol: The determinant is \(c^2-ab\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i-\hat k\), \(\vec b=x\hat i+\hat j+(1-x)\hat k\) and \(\vec c=y\hat i+x\hat j+(1+x-y)\hat k\). Then \([\vec a,\vec b,\vec c]\) depends on
questions.sol: Adding \(C_1\) to \(C_3\) makes column \(3\) equal to \((0,1,1+x)\); the determinant simplifies to \(1\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) are non-coplanar vectors and \(\lambda\) is a real number, then the vectors \(\vec a+2\vec b+3\vec c\), \(\lambda\vec b+4\vec c\) and \((2\lambda-1)\vec c\) are non-coplanar for
questions.sol: The coefficient determinant is \(\lambda(2\lambda-1)\), zero for \(\lambda=0,\tfrac12\).

questions.q: If \(\vec u,\vec v\) and \(\vec w\) are three non-coplanar vectors, then \((\vec u+\vec v-\vec w)\cdot(\vec u-\vec v)\times(\vec v-\vec w)\) equals
questions.sol: Coefficient determinant \(\begin{vmatrix}1&1&-1\\1&-1&0\\0&1&-1\end{vmatrix}=1\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) are vectors such that \([\vec a\ \vec b\ \vec c]=4\) then \([\vec a\times\vec b\ \ \vec b\times\vec c\ \ \vec c\times\vec a]=\)
questions.sol: It equals \([\vec a\vec b\vec c]^2\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b=2\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec d=\vec a\times\vec b\). If \(\vec c\) is a vector such that \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=|\vec c|\), \(|\vec c-2\vec a|^2=8\) and the angle between \(\vec d\) and \(\vec c\) is \(\dfrac\pi4\), then \(|10-3\vec b\cdot\vec c|+|\vec d\times\vec c|^2\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(|\vec c|^2-4|\vec c|+12=8\Rightarrow|\vec c|=2\); \(\vec d=(-1,1,0)\). \(|\vec d\times\vec c|^2=2\cdot4\cdot\tfrac12=4\). Solving for \(\vec c\): \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=4\) or \(\tfrac83\), and in both cases \(|10-3\vec b\cdot\vec c|=2\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\). If \(\vec c\) is a vector such that \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=11\), \(\vec b\cdot(\vec a\times\vec c)=27\) and \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=-\sqrt3|\vec b|\), then \(|\vec a\times\vec c|^2\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: Three linear equations determine \(\vec c\); then \(|\vec a\times\vec c|^2=|\vec a|^2|\vec c|^2-(\vec a\cdot\vec c)^2=285\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec v=\alpha\hat i+2\hat j-3\hat k\), \(\vec w=2\alpha\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\vec u\) be a vector such that \(|\vec u|=\alpha>0\). If the minimum value of the scalar triple product \([\vec u\ \vec v\ \vec w]\) is \(-\alpha\sqrt{3401}\), and \(|\vec u\cdot\hat i|^2=\dfrac mn\) where \(m\) and \(n\) are coprime natural numbers, then \(m+n\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec v\times\vec w=(1,-5\alpha,-3\alpha)\); the minimum is \(-\alpha|\vec v\times\vec w|\), so \(1+34\alpha^2=3401\), \(\alpha=10\). Then \(\vec u=-\tfrac{10}{\sqrt{3401}}(1,-50,-30)\) and \((\vec u\cdot\hat i)^2=\tfrac{100}{3401}\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) be three non-zero non-coplanar vectors. Let the position vector of four points \(A,B,C\) and \(D\) be \(\vec a-\vec b+\vec c\), \(\lambda\vec a-3\vec b+4\vec c\), \(-\vec a+2\vec b-3\vec c\) and \(2\vec a-4\vec b+6\vec c\) respectively. If \(\overrightarrow{AB},\overrightarrow{AC}\) and \(\overrightarrow{AD}\) are coplanar, then \(\lambda\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\begin{vmatrix}\lambda-1&-2&3\\-2&3&-4\\1&-3&5\end{vmatrix}=3\lambda-6=0\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a=2\hat i+\hat j+3\hat k\), \(\vec b=3\hat i+3\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec c=c_1\hat i+c_2\hat j+c_3\hat k\) are coplanar vectors and \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=5\), \(\vec b\perp\vec c\), then \(122(c_1+c_2+c_3)\) is equal to ______.

Let \(\vec a=\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c=\hat j-\hat k\) be three vectors such that \(\vec a\times\vec b=\vec c\) and \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=1\). If the length of projection vector of the vector \(\vec b\) on the vector \(\vec a\times\vec c\) is \(l\), then the value of \(3l^2\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: Solving \(\vec a\times\vec b=\vec c\), \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=1\) gives \(\vec b=\hat i\). \(\vec a\times\vec c=(-2,1,1)\), so \(l=\tfrac2{\sqrt6}\) and \(3l^2=2\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i-\alpha\hat j+\beta\hat k\), \(\vec b=3\hat i+\beta\hat j-\alpha\hat k\) and \(\vec c=-\alpha\hat i-2\hat j+\hat k\), where \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\) are integers. If \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=-1\) and \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=10\), then \((\vec a\times\vec b)\cdot\vec c\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: The integer solution is \(\alpha=-2,\ \beta=-1\); then \([\vec a\vec b\vec c]=9\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec c\) be a vector perpendicular to the vectors \(\vec a=\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k\). If \(\vec c\cdot(\hat i+\hat j+3\hat k)=8\), then the value of \(\vec c\cdot(\vec a\times\vec b)\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec a\times\vec b=(3,-2,1)\), \(\vec c=k(3,-2,1)\) with \(4k=8\): \(\vec c\cdot(\vec a\times\vec b)=2\cdot14\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a=\alpha\hat i+\beta\hat j+3\hat k\), \(\vec b=-\beta\hat i-\alpha\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\vec c=\hat i-2\hat j-\hat k\) such that \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=1\) and \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=-3\), then \(\dfrac13((\vec a\times\vec b)\cdot\vec c)\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(-2\alpha\beta-3=1\) and \(2\alpha-\beta+1=-3\); then \([\vec a\vec b\vec c]=6\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec x\) be a vector in the plane containing vectors \(\vec a=2\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k\). If the vector \(\vec x\) is perpendicular to \(3\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k\) and its projection on \(\vec a\) is \(\dfrac{17\sqrt6}2\), then the value of \(|\vec x|^2\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec x=p\vec a+q\vec b\): \(5p+8q=0\) and \(\tfrac{6p+q}{\sqrt6}=\tfrac{17\sqrt6}2\). Solving, \(|\vec x|^2=486\).

questions.q: Let three vectors \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) be such that \(\vec c\) is coplanar with \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\), \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=7\) and \(\vec b\) is perpendicular to \(\vec c\), where \(\vec a=-\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec b=2\hat i+\hat k\), then the value of \(2|\vec a+\vec b+\vec c|^2\) is ______.
questions.sol: \(\vec c=p\vec a+q\vec b\) with \(3p-q=7\) and \(-p+5q=0\): \(p=\tfrac52,\ q=\tfrac12\), \(\vec c=\left(-\tfrac32,\tfrac52,3\right)\). Then \(\vec a+\vec b+\vec c=\left(-\tfrac12,\tfrac72,5\right)\) and \(2|\cdot|^2=75\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a=2\hat i+\hat j+2\hat k\), then the value of \(|\hat i\times(\vec a\times\hat i)|^2+|\hat j\times(\vec a\times\hat j)|^2+|\hat k\times(\vec a\times\hat k)|^2\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol: \(\hat i\times(\vec a\times\hat i)=\vec a-a_x\hat i\), of squared length \(|\vec a|^2-a_x^2\). Sum \(3\cdot9-9\).

questions.q: If the vectors, \(\vec p=(a+1)\hat i+a\hat j+a\hat k\), \(\vec q=a\hat i+(a+1)\hat j+a\hat k\) and \(\vec r=a\hat i+a\hat j+(a+1)\hat k\) \((a\in R)\) are coplanar and \(3(\vec p\cdot\vec q)^2-\lambda|\vec r\times\vec q|^2=0\), then the value of \(\lambda\) is ______.
questions.sol: Coplanar: \(3a+1=0\), \(a=-\tfrac13\). Then \(\vec p\cdot\vec q=-\tfrac13\), \(|\vec r\times\vec q|^2=\tfrac13\): \(\tfrac13=\tfrac\lambda3\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=-\hat i+2\hat j+2\hat k\), \(\vec b=8\hat i+7\hat j-3\hat k\) and \(\vec c\) be a vector such that \(\vec a\times\vec c=\vec b\). If \(\vec c\cdot(\hat i+\hat j+\hat k)=4\), then \(|\vec a+\vec c|^2\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
Since \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=0\), \(\vec c=\dfrac{\vec b\times\vec a}{|\vec a|^2}+t\vec a\). Here \(\vec b\times\vec a=(20,-13,23)\), \(|\vec a|^2=9\).
\(\vec c\cdot(1,1,1)=\dfrac{30}{9}+3t=4\Rightarrow t=\dfrac29\), so \(\vec c=(2,-1,3)\).
\(\vec a+\vec c=(1,1,5)\), \(|\vec a+\vec c|^2=27\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec c\) and \(\vec d\) be vectors such that \(|\vec c+\vec d|=\sqrt{29}\) and \(\vec c\times(2\hat i+3\hat j+4\hat k)=(2\hat i+3\hat j+4\hat k)\times\vec d\). If \(\lambda_1,\lambda_2\) \((\lambda_1>\lambda_2)\) are the possible values of \((\vec c+\vec d)\cdot(-7\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k)\), then the equation \[K^2x^2+(K^2-5K+\lambda_1)xy+\left(3K+\frac{\lambda_2}{2}\right)y^2-8x+12y+\lambda_2=0\] represents a circle, for \(K\) equal to:
questions.sol:
With \(\vec n=(2,3,4)\): \(\vec c\times\vec n+\vec d\times\vec n=\vec 0\Rightarrow(\vec c+\vec d)\parallel\vec n\), and \(|\vec n|=\sqrt{29}\) gives \(\vec c+\vec d=\pm\vec n\).
\(\vec n\cdot(-7,2,3)=4\), so \(\lambda_1=4,\ \lambda_2=-4\).
Circle: no \(xy\) term \(\Rightarrow K^2-5K+4=0\Rightarrow K=1,4\); equal \(x^2,y^2\) coefficients \(\Rightarrow K^2=3K-2\Rightarrow K=1,2\).
So \(K=1\) (giving \(x^2+y^2-8x+12y-4=0\), a real circle).

questions.q: For a triangle \(ABC\), let \(\vec p=\overrightarrow{BC}\), \(\vec q=\overrightarrow{CA}\) and \(\vec r=\overrightarrow{BA}\). If \(|\vec p|=2\sqrt3\), \(|\vec q|=2\) and \(\cos\theta=\dfrac1{\sqrt3}\), where \(\theta\) is the angle between \(\vec p\) and \(\vec q\), then \(\left|\vec p\times(\vec q-3\vec r)\right|^2+3|\vec r|^2\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
\(\vec r=\vec p+\vec q\), so \(\vec p\times(\vec q-3\vec r)=\vec p\times(-2\vec q)\).
\(|\vec p\times\vec q|^2=12\cdot4\cdot\left(1-\tfrac13\right)=32\), so the first term is \(4\cdot32=128\).
\(|\vec r|^2=12+4+2\cdot2\sqrt3\cdot2\cdot\tfrac1{\sqrt3}=24\), so \(3|\vec r|^2=72\). Total \(=200\).

questions.q: Let \(\overrightarrow{AB}=2\hat i+4\hat j-5\hat k\) and \(\overrightarrow{AD}=\hat i+2\hat j+\lambda\hat k\), \(\lambda\in\mathbb{R}\). Let the projection of the vector \(\vec v=\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\) on the diagonal \(\overrightarrow{AC}\) of the parallelogram \(ABCD\) be of length one unit. If \(\alpha,\beta\), where \(\alpha>\beta\), are the roots of the equation \(\lambda^2x^2-6\lambda x+5=0\), then \(2\alpha-\beta\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
\(\overrightarrow{AC}=(3,6,\lambda-5)\). \(\dfrac{|\lambda+4|}{\sqrt{45+(\lambda-5)^2}}=1\Rightarrow(\lambda+4)^2=45+(\lambda-5)^2\Rightarrow\lambda=3\).
\(9x^2-18x+5=0\Rightarrow x=\tfrac53,\tfrac13\). \(2\alpha-\beta=\tfrac{10}{3}-\tfrac13=3\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=2\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\lambda\hat j+2\hat k\), \(\lambda\in\mathbb{Z}\), be two vectors. Let \(\vec c=\vec a\times\vec b\) and \(\vec d\) be a vector of magnitude \(2\) in the \(yz\)-plane. If \(|\vec c|=\sqrt{53}\), then the maximum possible value of \((\vec c\cdot\vec d)^2\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
\(\vec c=(-2-\lambda,\,-4,\,2\lambda)\); \(|\vec c|^2=(\lambda+2)^2+16+4\lambda^2=53\Rightarrow5\lambda^2+4\lambda-33=0\Rightarrow\lambda=-3\) (\(\lambda\in\mathbb{Z}\)).
\(\vec c=(1,-4,-6)\). With \(\vec d=(0,2\cos\phi,2\sin\phi)\): \(\max(\vec c\cdot\vec d)^2=4(16+36)=208\).

questions.q: Let a vector \(\vec a=\sqrt2\hat i-\hat j+\lambda\hat k\), \(\lambda>0\), make an obtuse angle with the vector \(\vec b=-\lambda^2\hat i+4\sqrt2\hat j+4\sqrt2\hat k\) and an angle \(\theta\), \(\dfrac\pi6<\theta<\dfrac\pi2\), with the positive \(z\)-axis. If the set of all possible values of \(\lambda\) is \((\alpha,\beta)-\{\gamma\}\), then \(\alpha+\beta+\gamma\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol:
Obtuse: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=-\sqrt2\lambda^2-4\sqrt2+4\sqrt2\lambda<0\iff(\lambda-2)^2>0\iff\lambda\ne2\) (and \(\vec a\) is never antiparallel to \(\vec b\) for \(\lambda>0\)).
\(\cos\theta=\dfrac{\lambda}{\sqrt{3+\lambda^2}}\in\left(0,\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}\right)\iff0<\lambda<3\).
So \(\lambda\in(0,3)-\{2\}\) and \(\alpha+\beta+\gamma=5\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=-\hat i+\hat j+2\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat i-\hat j-3\hat k\), \(\vec c=\vec a\times\vec b\) and \(\vec d=\vec c\times\vec a\). Then \((\vec a-\vec b)\cdot\vec d\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
\(\vec d=(\vec a\times\vec b)\times\vec a=|\vec a|^2\vec b-(\vec a\cdot\vec b)\vec a=6\vec b+8\vec a\) (since \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=-8\)).
\((\vec a-\vec b)\cdot\vec d=8|\vec a|^2-6|\vec b|^2+(6-8)\vec a\cdot\vec b=48-66+16=-2\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) be three vectors such that \(\vec a\times\vec b=2(\vec a\times\vec c)\). If \(|\vec a|=1\), \(|\vec b|=4\), \(|\vec c|=2\), and the angle between \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) is \(60^\circ\), then \(|\vec a\cdot\vec c|\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
\(\vec a\times(\vec b-2\vec c)=\vec0\Rightarrow\vec b-2\vec c=k\vec a\). \(|\vec b-2\vec c|^2=16+16-4(4)=16\Rightarrow|k|=4\).
Dotting with \(\vec c\): \(\vec b\cdot\vec c-2|\vec c|^2=k(\vec a\cdot\vec c)\Rightarrow4-8=k(\vec a\cdot\vec c)\), so \(|\vec a\cdot\vec c|=\dfrac44=1\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i-2\hat j+3\hat k\), \(\vec b=2\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\), \(\vec c=\lambda\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec v=\vec a\times\vec b\). If \(\vec v\cdot\vec c=11\) and the length of the projection of \(\vec b\) on \(\vec c\) is \(p\), then \(9p^2\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
\(\vec v=(-1,7,5)\); \(\vec v\cdot\vec c=-\lambda+12=11\Rightarrow\lambda=1\).
\(p=\dfrac{\vec b\cdot\vec c}{|\vec c|}=\dfrac{2}{\sqrt3}\), so \(9p^2=12\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=2\hat i+\hat j-2\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat i+\hat j\) and \(\vec c=\vec a\times\vec b\). Let \(\vec d\) be a vector such that \(|\vec d-\vec a|=\sqrt{11}\), \(|\vec c\times\vec d|=3\) and the angle between \(\vec c\) and \(\vec d\) is \(\dfrac\pi4\). Then \(\vec a\cdot\vec d\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
\(\vec c=(2,-2,1)\), \(|\vec c|=3\). \(|\vec c\times\vec d|=3|\vec d|\sin\tfrac\pi4=3\Rightarrow|\vec d|=\sqrt2\).
\(|\vec d-\vec a|^2=2+9-2\vec a\cdot\vec d=11\Rightarrow\vec a\cdot\vec d=0\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=2\hat i-\hat j-\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat i+3\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\vec c=2\hat i+\hat j+3\hat k\). Let \(\vec v\) be the vector in the plane of the vectors \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\), such that the length of its projection on the vector \(\vec c\) is \(\dfrac1{\sqrt{14}}\). Then \(|\vec v|\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
Take \(\vec v=\vec a+\lambda\vec b\) (the standard form for a vector in the plane of \(\vec a,\vec b\) intended here).
\(\vec a\cdot\vec c=0\), \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=2\), \(|\vec c|=\sqrt{14}\): \(\dfrac{2\lambda}{\sqrt{14}}=\dfrac1{\sqrt{14}}\Rightarrow\lambda=\tfrac12\).
Since \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=0\): \(|\vec v|^2=6+\tfrac14\cdot11=\tfrac{35}{4}\), so \(|\vec v|=\tfrac{\sqrt{35}}{2}\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=2\hat i-5\hat j+5\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\hat i-\hat j+3\hat k\). If \(\vec c\) is a vector such that \(2(\vec a\times\vec c)+3(\vec b\times\vec c)=\vec0\) and \((\vec a-\vec b)\cdot\vec c=-97\), then \(|\vec c\times\hat k|^2\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
\((2\vec a+3\vec b)\times\vec c=\vec0\Rightarrow\vec c=k(7,-13,19)\). \((\vec a-\vec b)\cdot\vec c=k(1,-4,2)\cdot(7,-13,19)=97k=-97\Rightarrow k=-1\).
\(\vec c=(-7,13,-19)\); \(|\vec c\times\hat k|^2=c_x^2+c_y^2=49+169=218\).

questions.q: For three unit vectors \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) satisfying \(|\vec a-\vec b|^2+|\vec b-\vec c|^2+|\vec c-\vec a|^2=9\) and \(|2\vec a+k\vec b+k\vec c|=3\), the positive value of \(k\) is:
questions.sol:
\(6-2\sum\vec a\cdot\vec b=9\Rightarrow\sum\vec a\cdot\vec b=-\tfrac32\Rightarrow|\vec a+\vec b+\vec c|^2=3-3=0\), so \(\vec b+\vec c=-\vec a\).
\(|2\vec a-k\vec a|=|2-k|=3\Rightarrow k=5\) (positive value).

questions.q: Let \(PQR\) be a triangle such that \(\overrightarrow{PQ}=-2\hat i-\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(\overrightarrow{PR}=a\hat i+b\hat j-4\hat k\), \(a,b\in\mathbb{Z}\). Let \(S\) be the point on \(QR\) which is equidistant from the lines \(PQ\) and \(PR\). If \(|\overrightarrow{PR}|=9\) and \(\overrightarrow{PS}=\hat i-7\hat j+2\hat k\), then the value of \(3a-4b\) is ______.
questions.sol:
(As printed, \(\overrightarrow{PS}\) is not exactly the vector to a point of \(QR\); the intended data is its direction.)
\(S\) lies on the internal bisector of \(\angle P\), whose direction is \(\dfrac{\overrightarrow{PQ}}{3}+\dfrac{\overrightarrow{PR}}{9}=\dfrac{(a-6,\,b-3,\,2)}{9}\).
Parallel to \((1,-7,2)\): \(a-6=1\), \(b-3=-7\Rightarrow a=7\), \(b=-4\) (and indeed \(a^2+b^2+16=81\)).
\(3a-4b=21+16=37\).

questions.q: Let \(P\) be a point in the plane of the vectors \(\overrightarrow{AB}=3\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\overrightarrow{AC}=\hat i-\hat j+3\hat k\) such that \(P\) is equidistant from the lines \(AB\) and \(AC\). If \(|\overrightarrow{AP}|=\dfrac{\sqrt5}{2}\), then the area of the triangle \(ABP\) is:
questions.sol:
\(|\overrightarrow{AB}|=|\overrightarrow{AC}|=\sqrt{11}\), so the internal bisector is along \(\overrightarrow{AB}+\overrightarrow{AC}=(4,0,2)\): \(\overrightarrow{AP}=\tfrac{\sqrt5}{2}\cdot\tfrac{(2,0,1)}{\sqrt5}=\left(1,0,\tfrac12\right)\).
\(\overrightarrow{AB}\times\overrightarrow{AP}=\left(\tfrac12,-\tfrac52,-1\right)\), magnitude \(\tfrac{\sqrt{30}}{2}\); area \(=\tfrac{\sqrt{30}}{4}\).
(The external bisector gives area \(\tfrac54\), not among the options.)

questions.q: If \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) are two vectors such that \(|\vec a|=2\) and \(|\vec b|=3\), then the maximum value of \(3\left|3\vec a+2\vec b\right|+4\left|3\vec a-2\vec b\right|\) is:

Let the vectors \(\vec a=-\hat i+\hat j+3\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\hat i+3\hat j+\hat k\). For some \(\lambda,\mu\in\mathbb{R}\), let \(\vec c=\lambda\vec a+\mu\vec b\). If \(\vec c\cdot(3\hat i-6\hat j+2\hat k)=10\) and \(\vec c\cdot(\hat i+\hat j+\hat k)=-2\), then \(|\vec c|^2\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
\(\vec c=(\mu-\lambda,\lambda+3\mu,3\lambda+\mu)\). Conditions: \(-3\lambda-13\mu=10\), \(3\lambda+5\mu=-2\Rightarrow\mu=-1\), \(\lambda=1\).
\(\vec c=(-2,-2,2)\), \(|\vec c|^2=12\).

questions.q: Two adjacent sides of a parallelogram \(PQRS\) are given by \(\overrightarrow{PQ}=\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\overrightarrow{PS}=\hat i-\hat j\). If the side \(PS\) is rotated about the point \(P\) by an acute angle \(\alpha\) in the plane of the parallelogram so that it becomes perpendicular to the side \(PQ\), then \(\sin^2\left(\dfrac{5\alpha}{2}\right)-\sin^2\left(\dfrac\alpha2\right)\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
\(\cos\angle QPS=\dfrac{-1}{\sqrt2\sqrt2}=-\tfrac12\), so the angle is \(120^\circ\) and \(\alpha=30^\circ\).
\(\sin^2A-\sin^2B=\sin(A+B)\sin(A-B)\): \(\sin^275^\circ-\sin^215^\circ=\sin90^\circ\sin60^\circ=\tfrac{\sqrt3}{2}\).

questions.q: Let \(\hat u\) and \(\hat v\) be unit vectors inclined at an acute angle such that \(|\hat u\times\hat v|=\dfrac{\sqrt3}{2}\). If \(\vec A=\lambda\hat u+\hat v+(\hat u\times\hat v)\), then \(\lambda\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
\(\hat u\cdot\hat v=\cos60^\circ=\tfrac12\). \(\vec A\cdot\hat u=\lambda+\tfrac12\), \(\vec A\cdot\hat v=\tfrac\lambda2+1\).
\(\tfrac43\left(\lambda+\tfrac12\right)-\tfrac23\left(\tfrac\lambda2+1\right)=\lambda\), so (a).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\sqrt7\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\hat j+2\hat k\). If \(\vec r\) is a vector such that \(\vec r\times\vec a+\vec a\times\vec b=\vec0\) and \(\vec r\cdot\vec a=0\), then \(|3\vec r|^2\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
\((\vec r-\vec b)\times\vec a=\vec0\Rightarrow\vec r=\vec b+t\vec a\). \(\vec r\cdot\vec a=-1+9t=0\Rightarrow t=\tfrac19\).
\(\vec r=\left(\tfrac{\sqrt7}{9},\tfrac{10}{9},\tfrac{17}{9}\right)\), \(|3\vec r|^2=\dfrac{7+100+289}{9}=44\).

questions.q: Let \(O\) be the origin, \(\overrightarrow{OP}=\vec a\) and \(\overrightarrow{OQ}=\vec b\). If \(R\) is the point on \(\overrightarrow{OP}\) such that \(\overrightarrow{OP}=5\overrightarrow{OR}\), and \(M\) is the point such that \(\overrightarrow{OQ}=5\overrightarrow{RM}\), then \(\overrightarrow{PM}\) is equal to:
questions.sol: \(\overrightarrow{OR}=\tfrac{\vec a}{5}\), \(\overrightarrow{OM}=\tfrac{\vec a}{5}+\tfrac{\vec b}{5}\). \(\overrightarrow{PM}=\tfrac{\vec a+\vec b}{5}-\vec a=\tfrac15(\vec b-4\vec a)\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a=\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\vec c\) be three vectors such that \(\vec a\times\vec c=\vec b\) and \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=3\), then \(\vec c\cdot(\vec a-2\vec b)\) is equal to ______.
questions.sol:
\(\vec a\times(\vec a\times\vec c)=(\vec a\cdot\vec c)\vec a-|\vec a|^2\vec c\Rightarrow\vec c=\dfrac{3\vec a-\vec a\times\vec b}{3}\). With \(\vec a\times\vec b=(-2,1,1)\): \(\vec c=\tfrac13(5,2,2)\).
\(\vec c\cdot(1,-1,3)=\tfrac{5-2+6}{3}=3\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=2\hat i+3\hat j+3\hat k\) and \(\vec b=6\hat i+3\hat j+3\hat k\). Then the square of the area of the triangle with adjacent sides determined by the vectors \((2\vec a+3\vec b)\) and \((\vec a-\vec b)\) is:
questions.sol:
\((2\vec a+3\vec b)\times(\vec a-\vec b)=-5\,\vec a\times\vec b\), and \(\vec a\times\vec b=(0,12,-12)\), \(|\vec a\times\vec b|=12\sqrt2\).
Area \(=\tfrac12\cdot60\sqrt2=30\sqrt2\); square \(=1800\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=4\hat i-\hat j+3\hat k\), \(\vec b=10\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k\) and a vector \(\vec c\) be such that \(2(\vec a\times\vec b)+3(\vec b\times\vec c)=\vec0\). If \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=15\), then \(\vec c\cdot(\hat i+\hat j-3\hat k)\) is equal to:
questions.sol:
\(\vec b\times(3\vec c-2\vec a)=\vec0\Rightarrow\vec c=\dfrac{2\vec a+k\vec b}{3}\). \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=\dfrac{52+35k}{3}=15\Rightarrow k=-\tfrac15\).
\(\vec a\cdot(1,1,-3)=-6\), \(\vec b\cdot(1,1,-3)=15\): \(\vec c\cdot(1,1,-3)=\dfrac{-12-3}{3}=-5\).
